races.race_name: Sky Bet Mile Handicap (Heritage Handicap)

runners.name: Welbury
runners.spotlight: Returned to winning ways at Pontefract (1m, good) last month and found a surge of improvement to follow up by 7l against 13 runners at Redcar (1m, good to firm); he's 11lb higher than last time and in a higher grade but it remains to be seen where his limitations now lie; unraced on slow ground.
runners.comment: Found a surge of improvement for 7l win at Redcar; of interest despite an 11lb rise

runners.name: Blue Courvoisier
runners.spotlight: All seven starts on good/good to firm; won the competitive Silver Bowl at Carlisle (1m) in May before mid-division at Royal Ascot, and he was a close third of 15 at Glorious Goodwood (1m1f) three weeks ago; could again be in the mix.
runners.comment: Close third of 15 at Glorious Goodwood and he could again be in the mix

runners.name: Daydreama
runners.spotlight: It was a small field at Ripon (1m, good to firm) in which he returned to form last time, when battling it out with Command The Stars and Noelan Star, and this is much more competitive; however, his two best RPRs have come at York and he's 4lb lower than when second of 14 here (7f, good) in May; could go well at a big price if conditions suit (unproven on slow ground).
runners.comment: Returned to form in small field at Ripon and his record at York catches the eye

runners.name: Zennor Storm
runners.spotlight: Won both 2yo starts and he's improved with each of his four handicap runs this term, finishing strongly in first-time cheekpieces (retained) for 1l second of 19 to Exclusive Code at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago; respected despite 5lb rise; unraced on slow ground.
runners.comment: Second of 19 to Exclusive Code at Glorious Goodwood and he's respected despite a 5lb rise

runners.name: Le Samourai
runners.spotlight: Well-beaten favourite on debut at Salisbury (7f, soft) in June but left that behind to win in a first-time tongue-tie (retained since) at Kempton (7f, AW); clear second under a penalty at Thirsk (1m, good) three weeks ago and this 450,000gns half-brother to multiple Group/Grade 1 winner Romantic Warrior could be on a good mark for this first handicap start.
runners.comment: Lightly raced and well bred; could be on a good mark for this first handicap start

runners.name: Jeddaal
runners.spotlight: Won at Chester (7.5f, good to soft) in June and ran well off this 5lb higher mark when 1l fourth of 11 at Thirsk (1m, good) three weeks ago; further improvement can't be ruled out but it's necessary if he's to return to winning ways in this hotter contest.
runners.comment: Won at Chester before close 4th at Thirsk; further improvement needed in this hotter race

runners.name: Bearish
runners.spotlight: All four starts on good/good to firm; posted her second win on handicap debut at Ayr (1m, good) last month; had just a neck to spare and is 5lb higher up in grade this afternoon, but that form has been franked by the placed horses and he could have more left in the tank.
runners.comment: 5lb rise for narrow win on h'cap debut at Ayr but form has been franked by placed horses

runners.name: Eklleem
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fourth attempt in Ripon novice (1m, good) in June, showing improved form and defying trouble in running to win comfortably on his second start since being gelded; his dam was a 1m2f Listed winner (on soft ground) and he has the potential to be better than his opening mark.
runners.comment: Convincing novice win at Ripon in June; has the potential to be better than opening mark

runners.name: Intense Vision
runners.spotlight: 2-2 in France last year (6.5f/1m, soft/very soft); yet to pose a threat in Britain but he kept on from the rear for 4l 11th of 19 behind Exclusive Code at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, which was encouraging, and he could be a serious force on today's slower ground.
runners.comment: Encouraging run at Glorious Goodwood and could be a serious force on today's slower ground

runners.name: Krasimir
runners.spotlight: Consistent sort who won Dundalk maiden (1m, AW) last month on his seventh start before close third on handicap debut at Galway (8.5f, yielding); he kicked clear turning for home last time and today's slightly shorter trip could be a positive; cheekpieces replace blinkers; each-way possibilities.
runners.comment: Close third on handicap debut at Galway and he's an each-way possible

runners.name: Start Me Up
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row at Chester (6f/7f, soft/good) in June and respectable efforts at Chester (7.5f, good) and Glorious Goodwood (7f, good to firm) since; however, he needs something extra on today's first attempt at 1m if he's to land a competitive handicap such as this.
runners.comment: Won two in a row at Chester in June; respectable efforts since but needs something extra

runners.name: St Anton
runners.spotlight: Made it three wins from his last four starts when returning to winning ways at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last month; had just a nose to spare and is 6lb higher today, but all of his wins have been narrow ones and he keeps defying the handicapper; has run well on good to soft (unraced on softer).
runners.comment: Three narrow wins from his last four starts and he keeps defying the handicapper

runners.name: Ironwill
runners.spotlight: Two 2yo wins (including on soft ground) and back on the scoresheet at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last month; another big run when second of 13 at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; he's a headstrong sort but that didn't stop him finishing strongly last time and this first crack at 1m is well worth a go; he's one to consider.
runners.comment: Headstrong sort but finished strongly over 7f at Glorious Goodwood; 1m is well worth a go

runners.name: Lion Of Alba
runners.spotlight: Fourth from good draw in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) before a lesser run at Newmarket (1m, good to firm); ran well in first-time tongue-tie at Glorious Goodwood (1m2f, good to firm) last time when shaping as though the return to 1m would help; however, others appeal more.
runners.comment: Shaped at Glorious Goodwood as though the return to 1m would help but others appeal more

runners.name: Storming Point
runners.spotlight: Placed on his first four starts (including on soft) and got going too late in first-time cheekpieces (retained) when sixth of 19 to Exclusive Code on handicap debut at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good to firm); a stronger gallop today would help his cause and he's not discounted.
runners.comment: Got going too late on handicap debut at Glorious Goodwood; a stronger gallop would help

runners.name: Noelan Star
runners.spotlight: Three wins from his five starts, awarded the race at Ripon (1m, good to firm) last month due to interference (Command The Stars demoted); however, it was a small field last time and he could be vulnerable now back into a more competitive contest; unraced on slow ground.
runners.comment: Awarded race at Ripon last month; could be vulnerable back into a more competitive contest

runners.name: Exclusive Code
runners.spotlight: Drawn on the wrong side at Royal Ascot on handicap debut and was a heavily backed winner at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, when making most; he did it in good style and a 9lb rise may not stop him this afternoon; ran well on good to soft last August, unraced on softer.
runners.comment: Heavily backed winner at Glorious Goodwood and a 9lb rise may not stop him

runners.name: Astrazar
runners.spotlight: Heavy-ground 2yo maiden winner who came from a tough position to win valuable final here (7f, good) last October; hasn't kicked on this season but he returned to his best with close second of six at Newmarket last month (1m, good to firm; ran minus a plate); worth a second look given his course form.
runners.comment: Won valuable final here last October; ran well last time; worth a second look

runners.name: Outback Heat
runners.spotlight: Won handicap debut at Ascot (1m, good) in May and second of 30 in the Britannia at the Royal meeting there (1m, good to firm) in June; he's 5lb higher than last time but is unexposed and could have plenty more to offer; firmly in calculations; unraced on slow ground.
runners.comment: Runner-up in the Britannia at Royal Ascot and could have plenty more to offer

runners.name: Command The Stars
runners.spotlight: 2yo Listed winner in France (1m, very soft) and, having been gelded, he was back on song at Ripon (1m, good to firm) last month when first past the post (demoted to third due to interference); slow ground would hold no fears but it was a small field last time and this race is much hotter.
runners.comment: Back on song when first past the post at Ripon (demoted) but this race is much hotter
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

races.race_name: Weatherbys Lonsdale Cup Stakes (Group 2)

runners.name: Illinois
runners.spotlight: The supremely reliable performer (acted on any going) of 2024 and most of 2025 has gone and most of his performances since have been pretty grim in comparison; this season's clear exception was when he made class tell with his sights lowered in the 2m5f Queen Alexandra at Royal Ascot, winning by a neck from French Master; the Goodwood Cup took him well out of his comfort zone again last time and he carried his head awkwardly, but the less demanding company today offers a bit of hope.
runners.comment: No longer reliable but won the Queen Alexandra; his sights are lowered somewhat again
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Amiloc
runners.spotlight: Tremendous progress last season; odds-on flop when rather forced to make the running in the Yorkshire Cup here on 2026 return; ran on nicely for a creditable sixth of 12 in a very strong Hardwicke at Royal Ascot (1m4f) next time but unseated leaving the stalls with a mishap in the Goodwood Cup (2m; 17-2); that leaves his stamina unproven but he stays at least 1m6f; unraced on softer than good to yielding; a leading contender if he gets this new trip and there's fair chance he will.
runners.comment: Stays at least 1m6f; unraced on worse than good to yielding; leading contender if he stays

runners.name: Mount Atlas
runners.spotlight: Close Listed third here (1m6f, good) on penultimate start and got up close home in a slowly run Group 3 over that same C&D (good to firm) on latest; he's never ventured beyond that and it's questionable whether it will suit; also needs a bit more improvement but he's regularly proved capable of that.
runners.comment: Gr3 win here; questionable whether new trip will suit; also needs a bit more improvement

runners.name: Caballo De Mar
runners.spotlight: Registered Group 1 wins at Longchamp last October (2m4f Cadran, very soft) and this May (near 2m, soft) and every bit as good when short-headed at Ascot (good to firm) earlier in May; 7-1 for the Gold Cup at Royal Ascot (2m4f, good to firm) nine weeks ago and raced in second for a long way before cracking in the final 2f (vet reported signs of heat stress); concedes 3lb all round today but tried to go head-to-head with the best stayers around last time and they are now absent; good chance if back to form.
runners.comment: Tried to go head-to-head with the best stayers around in Gold Cup and they are now absent

runners.name: Al Nayyir
runners.spotlight: No ground worries; pretty reliable and got back on the scoresheet at Meydan (1m6f Group 3) in February, with a creditable second here in the Yorkshire Cup in May; 22l seventh in Gold Cup at Royal Ascot (2m4f; 125-1) nine weeks ago when, unlike Caballo De Mar, he never figured; second (short-headed) and third in the last two editions of this race and has a place chance again.
runners.comment: 2nd (short-headed) and 3rd in last two editions of this race and has a place chance again

runners.name: French Master
runners.spotlight: Unraced on softer than good except when well beaten on debut; smart performer on his day, beaten a neck by Illinois in the 2m5f Queen Alexandra at Royal Ascot two starts back; far from disgraced when 33-1 fourth in the 2m Goodwood Cup last time and the return of blinkers (replacing recent cheekpieces) might add a bit of zip, but he's probably a place proposition at best.
runners.comment: Smart performer on his day, beaten a neck by Illinois in the 2m5f Queen Alexandra

runners.name: Quickthorn
runners.spotlight: Has won on almost any going; front-runner at his best and he's a fine sight when in full flow, including with a win in this race in 2022; well beaten in it, however, in 2023 and 2024; in fact something was missing in all his first three races in 2024 and although he ended that campaign winning a minor race that September, he's not been seen since; it would be some feat if he could return with a win.
runners.comment: Won this race in 2022 but well beaten in it in 2023 and 2024; off since September 2024

runners.name: Columbus
runners.spotlight: Probably acts on soft; 1m7f Group 3 winner in France in 2024 and third in a 1m4f German Group 1 last year; sold for 400,000euros last November and got off the mark over hurdles (second attempt) in a maiden at Galway three weeks ago, but his only run on the Flat for this yard was a poor one in the 2m5f Queen Alexandra at Royal Ascot (11-1); others look more solid.
runners.comment: His only run on the Flat for this yard was a poor one in the 2m5f Queen Alexandra (11-1)

races.race_name: Al Basti Equiworld Dubai Gimcrack Stakes (Group 2) (Colts & Geldings)

runners.name: Adaay Of Scarlett
runners.spotlight: All six starts on good/good to firm; he's found one too good in 6f Group 2 races on his last three starts and there's the worry the same thing will happen today; however, it's possible the winners he has bumped into are better than the rivals he faces here, and perhaps the first-time cheekpieces will eke out something extra; he can be bang there once more.
runners.comment: Runner-up in 6f Group 2 races on last three starts; he can be bang there once more

runners.name: Agamemnon
runners.spotlight: Suited by the step up to 6f with 2l Listed third to Arapaho Gold at Newbury (good to firm) last month and improved again when runner-up in Group 3 at Deauville (6f, good) since; bumped into an exciting filly in France and could have a part to play; unraced on slow ground.
runners.comment: Bumped into exciting filly when runner-up in Group 3 at Deauville; could have part to play

runners.name: Hell Of A Spin
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut (5f, AW) before going one better at Hamilton (5f, good), and he belied his 66-1 odds when keeping on for a fine third in the Group 3 Molecomb at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good to firm) last month; the step up to 6f could be a positive and he might not be far away.
runners.comment: 66-1 third in the Group 3 Molecomb and the step up to 6f could be a positive

runners.name: Arapaho Gold
runners.spotlight: Won in good style at Thirsk on first two starts (5f/6f, good to firm) and took the rise in grade in his stride when making it 3-3 in Listed race at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last month; deserves extra credit for that neck win from a Godolphin colt as he was hampered early; there can be optimism that this highly likeable prospect will continue to progress; key player.
runners.comment: Made it 3-3 with Listed win at Newbury last month and he's a key player

runners.name: Final Objective
runners.spotlight: All four starts over 6f on good/good to firm; beaten only 2l when fading into seventh of 21 in the Group 2 Coventry at Royal Ascot and readily got off the mark when 1-6 for a maiden at Thirsk (6f, good) last Friday; this flat track could suit better than Ascot and he's not ruled out each-way.
runners.comment: Close seventh in the Coventry at Royal Ascot and this flat track could suit better

runners.name: Never Enough
runners.spotlight: Went close on debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in June and made all at Ascot (6f, good to firm) last month; today is a much tougher test of his credentials but his dam was a 5f Listed winner and his respected trainer has stated he has "masses of scope to go on in the future"; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Made all at Ascot on second start and could have plenty more to offer; not ruled out

runners.name: Marco Polo
runners.spotlight: 525,000gns yearling who is a brother to 7f Listed winner Saber Strike; Aidan O'Brien second string when eye-catching second of 19 at 14-1 on recent debut at the Curragh (6f, good to firm); takes a swift leap in grade here but he's the sole Ballydoyle runner and could be a very bright prospect.
runners.comment: Runner-up on debut in recent maiden at the Curragh; sole Ballydoyle runner; intriguing

runners.name: Matteo
runners.spotlight: Impressive on debut at Beverley (5f, good) in April and followed up by a short head from Ronson in a conditions race there (5f, good to firm) in May; a sizeable step forward is needed on this first run since but the Gimcrack has been the target and his trainer has won this four times; could go well.
runners.comment: 2-2, both at Beverley; sizeable step forward needed but trainer has a good record in this

runners.name: Ronson
runners.spotlight: All four starts over 5f on good/good to firm; 5l win at Beverley on second run before near-miss behind Matteo there and 2l fourth in Listed race at Sandown last time; it seems likely his limitations will again be exposed.
runners.comment: 2l Listed fourth at Sandown last time and likely his limitations will again be exposed

runners.name: Great Oak
runners.spotlight: From the family of French 1m/1m2f Group 1 winner Silasol and sent off at 1-3 when winning a match by a neck on debut at Ayr (6f, good to firm) last month; today's opposition is vastly tougher and lots of improvement is needed but he's from a powerful 2yo yard and a market move would be interesting.
runners.comment: Narrow winner of a match on debut; lots of improvement needed but from powerful 2yo yard

runners.name: Mussab
runners.spotlight: Promising third on debut over C&D (good) in May and built on that when third of 21 in the Group 2 Norfolk Stakes at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) two months ago; his strong finish last time firmly suggests today's return to 6f will be ideal and he's on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Stayed on well for third in the 5f Norfolk at Royal Ascot; return to 6f should be ideal

races.race_name: Coolmore City Of Troy Nunthorpe Stakes (Group 1)

runners.name: Pershaada
runners.spotlight: Out of a Listed winner on soft; has improved with each of three turf runs at 5f (good and good to firm) and picked up impressively in 2yo Group 3 at the big Goodwood meeting, considering she had to wait for a run; looks capable of better and has to be respected in receipt of a big weight allowance.
runners.comment: Improving; impressed in 2yo Group 3 at Goodwood; respected with big weight allowance

runners.name: Mission Central
runners.spotlight: Started the year with two Listed wins at 5f before charging up the stands' side to snatch the Group 1 King Charles III at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) from under Rayevka's nose; not the same horse in the Group 1 July Cup at Newmarket after (6f; had good form at the trip as a 2yo) where he wouldn't have won at 5f and was eased down; has a question mark now but he's capable of putting his stamp on this race if on song.
runners.comment: Good track position when winning 5f Group 1 at Ascot; well held at 6f since; could revive

runners.name: Bacio
runners.spotlight: Front-runs; all turf races on firm and good to firm; an unknown quantity for the 5f 3yo handicap at Royal Ascot but not any more as he justified strong market support when keeping daylight between himself and his rivals throughout; this track should suit him even better and, if coping with the change in the weather, he would have a lot going for him.
runners.comment: Impressed in 5f 3yo handicap at Royal Ascot; this track should suit better; major player

runners.name: Night Raider
runners.spotlight: Has taken time to get to grips with turf and was easily seen off when fourth in this last year; however, a gelding operation in the close season has worked wonders and he followed a Group 3 win with one in a Group 2 at Haydock (5f, good to soft), overcoming a slow start to win in some style; his star has dimmed somewhat at Royal Ascot and Goodwood since, but the return to a flat track offers hope that he can be on song again.
runners.comment: Smart form since gelded; below best last two runs but the return to a flat track can suit

runners.name: Rayevka
runners.spotlight: Stays 6f well but this looks her trip and, following a Group 3 win at Longchamp (soft) she so nearly held on in the King Charles III (good to firm) at Royal Ascot, where Mission Central was better positioned on the stands' side; has come from off the pace on her last two starts, which is a worry on this track, but she has a strong form chance.
runners.comment: Won Group 3 on soft before losing out late on at Royal Ascot; strong form chance
runners.owner: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C

runners.name: Cover Up
runners.spotlight: Has won on soft and yielding ground but best on good or quicker; came from the clouds before meeting trouble in running in the King Charles III at Royal Ascot, so did well to finish about 3l behind the winner; again came from behind when leading near the line in a Group 2 at the Curragh since; in prime form but those tactics can be hard to pull off here.
runners.comment: In prime form, hampered in Group 1 at Royal Ascot but led near the line in Group 2 since

runners.name: Heavenly Heather
runners.spotlight: Her tremendous progress was highlighted by a close sixth in the King Charles III at Royal Ascot (good to firm, probably acts on soft) but her hopes were ended by some interference in C&D Listed race won by Redorange next time; her finding a bit more even now can't be ruled out but this bar is high.
runners.comment: Cracking close 6th in the King Charles III; hampered since; this bar is high

runners.name: Partisan Hero
runners.spotlight: Some good efforts over 5f this year but he has met his match in Group races won by Rumstar, Cover Up and American Affair on his last three starts and has it to prove in this company.
runners.comment: Some useful 5f form but has met his match in Group races won by three of these rivals

runners.name: Asfoora
runners.spotlight: Made an indelible impression when taking Royal Ascot by storm in the King Charles III two years ago and adding two more Group 1s in 2025 with this race (good to firm) and the Abbaye (very soft); has held on to much of her ability in 2026, not far away back at Royal Ascot and going down narrowly to American Affair in a Group 2 at Goodwood recently, but it's not certain that she still has what it takes to add to last year's win.
runners.comment: Winner of three Group 1s, including this race; retains ability but probably not all of it

runners.name: Fitzella
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner over 6f at Ascot as a 2yo and she ran her best race of the year back there when fifth of 22 in the Commonwealth Cup in June; has had excuses since and although she should have plenty to find at this level in only her second 5f run, at least the track will suit her front-running style.
runners.comment: Group 3 winner at 6f as a 2yo; tough task but at least the track will suit now back at 5f

runners.name: American Affair
runners.spotlight: Said goodbye to handicaps when winning over C&D in May 2025 and just two runs later he won the Group 1 King Charles III at Royal Ascot (good to firm; handles good to soft); off the track for nearly a year after and he's been slowly working his way back to form since, looking more his old self when winning a Group 2 at Glorious Goodwood latest; a likely force.
runners.comment: Improving in 2025 when won Group 1 at Ascot; missed nearly a year; won Group 2 latest

runners.name: Rumstar
runners.spotlight: Has four Group 3 wins (on good and good to firm) under his belt; outward appearances suggest this level is beyond him but if the door had opened in time for him in this last year he might have been placed instead of finishing only fifth; frame chance.
runners.comment: Four Group 3 wins; hampered when 5th in this last year; has a frame chance

runners.name: Redorange
runners.spotlight: All turf races on good or quicker ground; best form when narrow winner of a C&D Listed race in July but his sights are raised much higher today in this, his first Group race.
runners.comment: Best form to win C&D Listed race in July; sights raised much higher in first Group race

runners.name: Time For Sandals
runners.spotlight: Won Group 1 Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot in 2025, then finished a close third to Jm Jungle in a Group 2 at Goodwood (5f, good to soft); she's had a chequered 2026 but the return to Goodwood last time may have helped when again close up in third; needs to find more in this company.
runners.comment: Close up in a Group 2 over 5f at Goodwood for the last two years; needs to find more
runners.owner: D Bevan And Mrs D Bevan

runners.name: Ain't Nobody
runners.spotlight: Rose far above his previous form when second of 17 to Asfoora in this race (100-1) last year in first-time cheekpieces but their effect was fleeting and subsequent runs, including in a handicap, don't offer much hope today; has now been gelded.
runners.comment: Runner-up in this race last year (100-1); nothing similar since; has now been gelded

runners.name: Azure Angel
runners.spotlight: Has not yet won above Listed level; anything but disgraced when mid-division in the King Charles III at Royal Ascot or when a close fifth to Redorange in a C&D Listed race after, but it's hard to see her in this picture.
runners.comment: Has not won above Listed level; creditable show at Ascot; hard to see her in this picture

runners.name: Starlust
runners.spotlight: Finished a close third in the 2024 running and went on to win the Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint (5f, firm; has won on good to soft) later in the year; seen only twice in 2025 and it's been a slow process recapturing form but a recent close fourth to Redorange in a C&D Listed race (first-time visor, now discarded) in July was better; no surprise to see him go well at a price.
runners.comment: Close 3rd in this race in 2024; had time off and slow to recapture form but better latest

runners.name: Jm Jungle
runners.spotlight: Handles most ground; best form when winning a Group 2 on good to soft at Glorious Goodwood in 2025 and although he hasn't nailed it in the same way this year, the recent rain could give him a toehold into this race; visored once as a 2yo, now goes in blinkers.
runners.comment: Handles most ground; won Group 2 in 2025; not quite at his best this year; rain helpful
runners.owner: MPS Racing Ltd & The Ayrshire Tradesmen

races.race_name: Assured Data Protection Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Plage De Havre
runners.spotlight: Won in great style at Haydock (1m4f, good; unraced on softer) last July and put up a bold show over C&D this May; having been a non-runner at Royal Ascot where the good to firm ground was deemed unsuitable, he ran on it at Newmarket seven weeks ago and disappointed; can go well if back to peak form.
runners.comment: Disappointed on good to firm last time, unraced on softer than good; player on peak form

runners.name: Jimmy Speaking
runners.spotlight: Acts on soft; unproven beyond 1m and unraced beyond 1m1f until he tried 1m3f at Southwell (AW) 15 days ago and led 2f out until three rivals went past in the final 1f; that was a good run and his dam won at this trip but others clearly have less to prove in this hot 1m4f race.
runners.comment: Unraced beyond 1m1f until he tried 1m3f at Southwell (AW) 15 days ago for a creditable 4th

runners.name: Tycoon
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten at Epsom on Oaks day on sole start on softer than good; upped to 1m4f (good to firm) for his two starts since when third of eight at Ascot (made most) and second of ten under 7lb claimer at York, both solid efforts but a bit extra will be needed to win this; non-runner at Newmarket yesterday.
runners.comment: A bit extra will be needed to win this; non-runner at Newmarket yesterday

runners.name: Explode
runners.spotlight: Had wind surgery in January; he's since had three runs this summer and something has clicked in a major way on last two occasions as he registered a ready win in four-runner race at Catterick and had no problem making all in a five-runner race at Newbury (again 1m4f on good to firm) six days ago; has a 5lb penalty and this is a vastly more competitive race, but never better.
runners.comment: Something has clicked in a major way for 1m4f wins last two starts, albeit in small fields

runners.name: Say What You See
runners.spotlight: Acts on good to soft but unraced on soft since 2024 (trained was positive about it last September); no shortage of success beforehand but cheekpieces seem to have worked very well on last two starts when winning at York (1m2f, good) and running on well again for second at Southwell (1m4f, AW); raised another 3lb but came from an unpromising position last time and still has more to give.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces seem to have worked very well on last two starts; still has more to give

runners.name: Wave Rider
runners.spotlight: Probably acts on soft; off four months (given wind surgery) before shaping as if back in good form when mid-division at Glorious Goodwood (1m2f) last month, not getting best of runs and finishing with more to give, which might also be encouraging for this first crack at 1m4f; needs a career best in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Needs a career best at new trip in first cheekpieces but latest start gave encouragement

runners.name: Ernst Blofeld
runners.spotlight: Unraced on softer than good; it looked as if 1m6f stretched him when seventh of 16 at Royal Ascot (every chance 2f out) and that he probably remained in form; however, he again came up short when favourite back over 1m4f at Ascot on latest start; something to prove after that.
runners.comment: Unraced on softer than good; shaped well penultimate run; something to prove after latest

runners.name: Sportingsilvermine
runners.spotlight: Placed twice on soft last year; beat only one home in a top 1m2f handicap here in July but in career-best form over 1m4f (good to firm) either side of that when winning at Newmarket and second in Shergar Cup race at Ascot; needs some respect.
runners.comment: Big runs (1st and 2nd) on his last two 1m4f starts mean that he needs some respect

runners.name: Zanndabad
runners.spotlight: Two hurdle wins last autumn seem a pretty meagre return for his respected yard but he was unlucky when a strong-finishing third in the 2024 Chester Cup (2m2f) and much the same can be argued for his fourth in this race last year when denied a clear run at crucial stage (3lb lower today); usually makes inroads far too late, as in the Chester Cup and Northumberland Plate last two outings, and stall 1 demands some luck here, but a sound pace up front could bring him into the equation.
runners.comment: Close 4th in this last year off 3lb higher; a sound pace up front could bring him into it

runners.name: French Duke
runners.spotlight: Made a winning stable debut from off the pace at Meydan (1m4f, good; acts on soft) in January but has finished no better than mid-division in his four starts since; has edged back to that last winning mark, which he also had when a close third in this race last year.
runners.comment: Finished no better than mid-division in last four starts; close third in this last year

runners.name: Cuff It
runners.spotlight: Made all, just holding on, in a novice at Windsor (1m2f, good to soft) in June on second start and the runner-up is 2-2 since; front-running fourth in a 1m3f novice at Kempton (AW) 16 days ago was creditable; dark horse but much more is needed in this hot race for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Pretty useful in last two novices; dark horse but much more is needed on handicap debut

runners.name: Primo Lara
runners.spotlight: Won at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) last month for Jack Morland and, following a 22,000gns sale, he was back with his former yard when following up in 15-runner race at Ascot (upped to 1m4f, good to firm; always close up) four weeks ago; back up another 7lb but his peak 2024 form (a win on good to soft here) was better still; on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Bids for a hat-trick and his peak 2024 form (a win on good to soft here) was better still

runners.name: Master Vintner
runners.spotlight: First two wins were on heavy/AW; there have been a couple of disappointments in his eight-race career but he followed two AW seconds by winning a six-runner race at Thirsk (1m4f, good) two weeks ago; up 5lb in this much more competitive race but he won in clearcut style in first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Up 5lb in this much more competitive race but he won in clearcut style in first blinkers
runners.owner: R A Pegum And Paul Anthony Henry

runners.name: Master Builder
runners.spotlight: Floundered on testing ground in the last two November Handicaps at Doncaster but he ran well on soft at this track in October 2024; well-backed favourite off a good mark when he reappeared over C&D (good) in May and he scored smoothly, in charge from 2f out; off since and back up 7lb but has to be considered seriously.
runners.comment: Well-backed favourite off good mark when smooth winner over C&D (good) in May; back up 7lb

runners.name: Shadow Dance
runners.spotlight: No ground worries but his career highlights (1m4f/1m6f) were in 2024, including a win in this race; 6lb lower today but that's after a rather muted 2025 when still with Roger Varian and his form went badly the wrong way in three runs this January-April for new connections; tongue-tie and/or cheekpieces, both fitted for the first time, need to work the oracle.
runners.comment: Won this in 2024 off 6lb higher; he's gone badly the wrong way, though; equipment goes on

runners.name: Genealogy
runners.spotlight: Formerly with Aidan O'Brien and Denis Hogan; well held on the Flat in Ireland this April; had wind surgery after failing to land the odds (bled from nose) in a maiden hurdle in June on debut for Faye Bramley; no mistake at 1-2 in a similar event at Stratford in July, which is far removed from today's task, though, and a big career best is needed on this.
runners.comment: Winning a Stratford maiden hurdle in July (after wind op) is far removed from today's task

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Convivial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Oklahoma
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt out of the stable's Group 1 winner Hydrangea; has multiple Group-race entries; beaten by a likely smart stablemate on debut (7f, good to firm) and, although turned over from the front when odds-on at Killarney (1m, good), he was only a length off City Of Dubai who has since gone close in a Listed race; has a very similar profile to the yard's last two winners of this (2023 and 2025) who stepped up plenty on their third starts; now goes in cheekpieces; strongly considered.
runners.comment: Two promising runs; likely improver and has strong form claims as it is
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Launch Sequence
runners.spotlight: Did have a Gimcrack entry and still engaged in other Group races; has come up short in two races over 6f (good to firm/good; the latest a valuable maiden at Glorious Goodwood) but those front-foot finishes suggest this extra furlong could make a big difference to him; firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: Has come up short in two 6f races but this extra furlong could make a big difference

runners.name: Speyside
runners.spotlight: Blue Point colt who defied odds of 40-1 when 3l third in a strongly run 7f maiden at Glorious Goodwood (good to firm), faring best of the newcomers from a midfield position at halfway; entered in the Group 1 Dewhurst and the fact that Oisin Murphy rides when Andrew Balding is represented raises expectations.
runners.comment: Encouraging third in a maiden at Glorious Goodwood and he's in the Dewhurst

runners.name: Game Character
runners.spotlight: 150,000gns yearling; third foal; half-brother to winners Goldwork (6f 2yo; RPR 80) and Stitching Wheel (1m6f; 73); dam French 7f winner (82), half-sister to winners Broderie (German 1m Listed) and Great Esteem (useful 1m4f); stable's 2yos have been going well all season and it makes sense to check the betting with Speyside from the same yard.
runners.comment: Stable's 2yos have been going well all season and it makes sense to check the betting

runners.name: My Remas
runners.spotlight: 150,000euros foal, 400,000gns breeze-up buy in April; first foal out of an Italian 1m winner and sister to winners Call Me Love (Italian 1m2f Group 2) and Cloud Free (1m); tongue tied for debut; stable won this in 2021 with Hoo Ya Mal (had the benefit of a run) who went on to finish second in the Derby; perhaps a slight concern that stable jockey Oisin Murphy is riding for Hugo Palmer.
runners.comment: 400,000gns breeze-up buy in April; stable won this with a smart colt in 2021

runners.name: Lancaster Tower
runners.spotlight: Entered in the Group 2 Royal Lodge and Group 1 Dewhurst; travelled well but seemingly found out by inexperience when a beaten odds-on favourite at Sandown (7f, good to firm); that form has been franked and let down in the last week, but this Kingman colt is open to any amount of improvement with that run under his belt, especially when evidently held in high regard.
runners.comment: Odds-on at Sandown and travelled well only to be found out by his inexperience
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Galipi
runners.spotlight: Positives to take from both his runs at about 7f (good to soft/good to firm) without suggesting he'll be capable of getting competitive in a maiden of this strength.
runners.comment: In a maiden of this strength, he's shown nothing like enough in his first two races

runners.name: Magwitch
runners.spotlight: 550,000gns yearling by star stallion Night Of Thunder; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Dhabab (Group-placed 5.5f-7f; RPR 114) and Celeres (French 10.5f); dam unraced half-sister to 6.5f-1m Listed winner Boomshackerlacker; one of the more appealing newcomers on paper, and trainer has introduced some smart horses at this track down the years.
runners.comment: 550,000gns yearling by star stallion Night Of Thunder; interesting newcomer
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Dover Street
runners.spotlight: £62,000 yearling by Brocklesby winner Persian Force; 13-2 for AW debut at Kempton (7f) where he momentarily threatened before going down by 2l; has to improve plenty on that effort in this much deeper contest.
runners.comment: Beaten 2l on AW debut and has to improve plenty on that effort in this much deeper contest

runners.name: Pete's Angel
runners.spotlight: Price increased from 82,000euros as a foal to 170,000euros as a yearling; fourth foal; brother to 5f/6f winner Amiata (RPR 89) and half-brother to Norwegian 6f-10.7f winner Icon Bling (107); dam 6f winner (72), closely related to two 5f 2yo winners; makes debut in fairly deep waters and others appeal more.
runners.comment: 170,000euros buy as a yearling; in deep waters for his debut and others appeal more

runners.name: The Thinking Man
runners.spotlight: 60,000gns yearling; first foal out of a 5.4f 2yo winner (RPR 68) and half-sister to 6f winner Peony; this race is a tough starter but stable is having a good season with 2yos and this colt is in the Two-Year-Old Trophy.
runners.comment: 60,000gns yearling; first foal out of a 5.4f 2yo winner; stable had good year with 2yos

runners.name: Master Celeritas
runners.spotlight: 24,000gns yearling, 110,000euros breeze-up purchase; fourth foal; half-brother to winners Zappata (7f/1m; RPR 74) and Crimson Rambler (1m/8.6f; 72); dam 1m/1m2f winner (99), half-sister to useful winners Shediak (6.5f-1m) and Shehira (1m); has been gelded; likely best watched.
runners.comment: 110,000euros breeze-up purchase; has been gelded and likely best watched

runners.name: Rossbeigh
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns breeze-up buy in April; third foal out of a prolific Italian 5f/6.5f winner and half-sister to Italian 5f/5.5f Listed winner Black Mambazo; hard to enthuse over when from a yard not noted for 2yo winners (0-14 last five seasons).
runners.comment: Hard to enthuse over when from a yard not noted for 2yo winners (0-14 last five seasons)

runners.name: Benjamin Hornigold
runners.spotlight: 50,000euros breeze-up buy; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Campaign Trail (1m4f-2m Flat, RPR 91; 2m1f/3m2f hurdle) and Green Gate (German 1m4f); dam German 1m1f/1m3f winner, half-sister to 2m4f Group 1 winner Colour Vision; everything would suggest he'll improve for longer distances but the trainer factor heightens interest for sure.
runners.comment: Bred to appreciate further in time but the trainer factor heightens interest for sure

runners.name: Sole Ambition
runners.spotlight: 210,000gns yearling; 100-30 at Ffos Las (6f, good) and finished a shade over 8l behind the favourite who was ninth in the Coventry; this colt was slowly away and should be all the wiser here, but this demands significant improvement from him.
runners.comment: Well-held third at Ffos Las and this race demands significant improvement from him

races.race_name: Sky Bet EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Folk Pageant
runners.spotlight: Won three handicaps in a row in May/June at about 1m2f (good/soft) but has gone off the boil subsequently; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Won three handicaps in a row in May/June but has gone off the boil subsequently
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Patagonia Girl
runners.spotlight: Made all in a big field at Chester (1m4f, good) in May and is just 1lb higher today but she hasn't come up to scratch subsequently and others arrive with more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Won at Chester in May off 1lb lower but hasn't come up to scratch subsequently

runners.name: Food For Thought
runners.spotlight: Won Nottingham novice (1m2f, good to firm) in June on fourth start and she's since been a clear second to unexposed handicap newcomers in two small-field contests (1m2f, good to firm; subsequent winner Silver Lake on the first occasion); she may yet have a bigger performance in her.
runners.comment: Runner-up in small fields in first two handicaps; may yet have a bigger performance in her
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Dunkeld Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Won the Queen Mother's Cup for female amateur jockeys here (1m4f, good) in June; not beaten far when fourth of five at Hamilton (1m5f, good) since but there's a suspicion that this will prove too competitive.
runners.comment: 1m4f course winner two starts ago but suspicion that this will prove too competitive

runners.name: Naga
runners.spotlight: Completed hat-trick on reappearance at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) in April and good third at Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) in May; respectable efforts in Group 3/Listed races on next two runs; she's 10lb higher than on her last handicap start but could still be a contender; unproven on slow ground.
runners.comment: Returns to a handicap on an inflated mark but could still be a contender

runners.name: Callianassa
runners.spotlight: She's 5lb lower than when winning at Newcastle (1m, AW) in February and when running well at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) in June; she's 0-12 on turf and unproven at this trip, and she's been below par at favourite course Newcastle on her last two starts (1m).
runners.comment: Won off this mark at Newcastle (1m, AW) in February but 0-12 on turf and others preferred

runners.name: Lady Dora Mae
runners.spotlight: 3yo who has been highly progressive and has continued the good work on her last two starts, with a 3l handicap second to Silver Lake at Goodwood (1m2f, good to firm) being followed by a Listed near-miss at Clairefontaine (1m4f, good to soft); there's every chance that she'll be bang there.
runners.comment: Progressive 3yo who was a close Listed second in France last Friday; bang there once more

runners.name: Plaid
runners.spotlight: Easy win at Hamilton (1m1f, good) in May on second handicap run and soft ground may not have suited at Goodwood next time; creditable Listed third at Hamilton (1m3f, good to firm) since and that form has been boosted here this week; this progressive 3yo could have a big part to play if conditions suit.
runners.comment: Listed third at Hamilton last month and that form has been boosted here this week

runners.name: Sharpen
runners.spotlight: Listed runner-up at Gowran Park (1m4f, good) last July and she's well handicapped on that form; following 360,000gns sale she may have needed the run on stable debut in Group 2 at Newmarket last month (first-time cheekpieces); however, she was tailed off and has something to prove after that; a tongue-tie is added.
runners.comment: Listed runner-up last July; may have needed last month's return but was tailed off

runners.name: Dream Camp
runners.spotlight: Won at Southwell (1m, AW) in May on third start and, after heavy defeat on handicap debut at Royal Ascot, she beat her six rivals to win at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last month; now back into a deeper race but this well-bred filly is in good hands to continue to progress; unraced on slow ground.
runners.comment: Won at Windsor on second handicap start and she's in good hands to continue to progress

runners.name: Pendella
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who was runner-up over C&D (good) in May and third at Epsom (1m2f, soft) next time; made all in small field at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) last month and, while she's up 3lb in a much hotter race today, she could continue to progress for her good yard; may make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Had just 3 rivals to beat at Beverley but this improving 3yo could make another bold bid

runners.name: Bint Al Daar
runners.spotlight: Second in this in 2024 (good to firm) and won at Southwell (1m3f, AW) in March but unplaced on her four starts since, well beaten at Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) most recently when reverting to turf following a break.
runners.comment: Second in this in 2024 and won on AW in March but unplaced on her four starts since

runners.name: Silver Lake
runners.spotlight: Improved upon her first three runs when upped in trip to win on handicap debut at Salisbury (1m2f, good to firm) last month and she followed up in dominant fashion at Glorious Goodwood (1m2f, good to firm); this unexposed 3yo could take a 9lb rise in her stride if conditions aren't an issue.
runners.comment: Made it 2-2 in handicaps with dominant performance at Glorious Goodwood; leading claims

runners.name: Bearin Up
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who finished held in fifth of nine over C&D (good to firm) six weeks ago when last seen; however, she's won twice this season (1m/8.3f, good) and split two progressive fellow 3yos when second at Chester (10.3f, good) two starts ago; not discounted at likely big odds.
runners.comment: Held in 5th over C&D latest but she's shown some strong form this season; not written off

runners.name: Rastnet
runners.spotlight: Won Wolverhampton novice (9.4f, AW) last December and placed this year in her first four handicaps; close fourth at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) recently after two-month break but form has to go to a new level in this hotter contest.
runners.comment: She's run some good races in defeat in handicaps but form has to go to a new level today

runners.name: Electrifarhh
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who showed improved form in a first-time hood (retained) with close third of 14 at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good) last month; shaped on that occasion as though this first crack at 1m2f would be worth a go; might be involved; hinted at promise on soft ground on debut in 2024.
runners.comment: Improved form in first-time hood at Glorious Goodwood & first crack at 1m2f is worth a go

runners.name: Janey Mackers
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has an up-and-down profile but won a handicap at Newbury (1m2f, good to soft) last September and fared best of those to come from off the pace when third on her reappearance at Chester (10.3f, good) in May; returns from another break and slow ground would boost her claims.
runners.comment: Encouraging third on sole start this season and slow ground would boost her claims

races.race_name: Racing Welfare Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Beguiled
runners.spotlight: 72,000gns yearling by Make Believe; weak 16-1 shot in a maiden at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago, but she finished well to snatch third behind the two market leaders; that was a striking debut and she sets a good standard on that form; holds a Group 1 entry in the Fillies' Mile.
runners.comment: Showed plenty of promise when third at Glorious Goodwood and she sets a good standard

runners.name: Show Me Glory
runners.spotlight: St Mark's Basilica filly; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Beat The Bank (multiple 1m Group 2), Chil Chil (6f Group 3) and Auria (1m Listed), out of useful 6f 2yo winner; interesting newcomer and she needs a close look in market.
runners.comment: Out of a half-sister to a Group 1 winner and she needs a close look on debut

runners.name: Zirconic
runners.spotlight: 110,000gns foal, 70,000gns yearling; second foal; half-sister to Italian 1m1f 2yo winner Drago Blues (including Listed; RPR 90); dam French 7f/US 1m winner (96), half-sister to winners Ouraika (US 6.5f Grade 3 turf), Complication (7f) and Santara (German 7.5f 2yo); another well-bred newcomer and the market should point the way.
runners.comment: 70.000gns yearling; another well-bred newcomer and the market should point the way

runners.name: Jessica
runners.spotlight: 200,000euros yearling; half-sister to to three winners including Pierre Bonnard (1m/1m2f 2yo including Group 1; RPR 119) and Crepe Suzette (Group-placed 9.4f AW; 110); ran green when fifth of seven in a C&D novice three weeks ago but that was behind a smart prospect and she wasn't beaten far; should know more this time and she's a likely improver on her second start.
runners.comment: Ran green over C&D three weeks ago but she wasn't beaten far behind a smart prospect

runners.name: Late Night Show
runners.spotlight: 120,000euros yearling; second foal; dam 1m winner (RPR 98), half-sister to winners Sea La Rosa (1m6f Group 1) and Deauville Legend (1m4f Group 2), out of German 1m3f Listed winning sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner Hanami; plenty to like on paper and yard is 26% with 2yos this season.
runners.comment: 120,000euros yearling; plenty to like on paper and yard is 26% with 2yos this season
runners.owner: Katy Jane Reed And Edward J Ware

runners.name: Woollahra
runners.spotlight: 110,000gns yearling; fourth foal; sister to winners Quatre Bras (7f 2yo/10.6f AW; RPR 89) and Casa De Salinas (1m AW 2yo; 73); dam 6f-8.4f winner (including AW/Group 3; 104), half-sister to German 1m2f Group 3 winner Waleria; has good standard to aim at on debut and market should guide.
runners.comment: 110,000gns yearling; has good standard to aim at on debut and market should guide

runners.name: Give Me A Bow
runners.spotlight: Stradivarius filly who struggled at 50-1 in a C&D novice (good to firm) on recent debut; opposable.
runners.comment: Stradivarius filly who struggled at 50-1 in a C&D novice (good to firm) on recent debut

races.race_name: British EBF Novice Stakes (Colts & Geldings)

runners.name: Majestic Jude
runners.spotlight: 160,000gns breeze-up 2yo; ran green at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm; 16-1) last month, but he kept on well and was beaten less than 2l in fifth of six; that form isn't strong but he should know more this time and is a likely improver; respected.
runners.comment: Ran green at Yarmouth but he wasn't beaten far and is a likely improver here

runners.name: Al Jabbar
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars colt; fourth foal; dam French 11.5f winner, half-sister to winners Hunter's Light (1m1f/1m2f Group 1) and Linda Radlett (useful 9.5f-1m4f; dam of 1m4f Group 2 winner Fanny Logan), out of 1m2f winning half-sister to 12.5f Group 2 winner Courteous; looks the part on paper and he's a striking newcomer for yard with 42% record with 2yos this season.
runners.comment: Well-bred colt and he's a striking newcomer for yard with 42% record with 2yos this season

runners.name: On Target
runners.spotlight: Didn't live up to market expectations on Sandown debut (5-1) last month and he was well held again when fourth of six at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) last week; still early days but others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Well held in both his runs, with a best RPR of 58; others preferred

runners.name: Astabuen
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Venencia (8.5f/9.5f including French AW 2yo/US turf stakes; RPR 108), Pop Life (French 1m2f/1m5f) and Twolatebabydoll (US 5.5f turf); dam French 11.7f winner, out of French 7f Listed winner; yard 15% with 2yos this season and he needs watching in market on debut.
runners.comment: 100,000euros yearling; yard 15% with 2yos this season and market should guide on debut

runners.name: Moheebb
runners.spotlight: 80-1 on Yarmouth debut (7f, good to firm) last month and he faded into a well-held last of six; finished behind Majestic Jude in that race and he's probably one for later on.
runners.comment: 80-1 and he finished last of six on recent Yarmouth debut (7f, good to firm)

runners.name: Nidal
runners.spotlight: 50-1 and he finished tailed off in last of eight on recent C&D debut (good to firm).
runners.comment: 50-1 and he finished tailed off in last of eight on recent C&D debut (good to firm)

races.race_name: Racing TV Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Seeing Stars
runners.spotlight: Won a Kempton maiden (7f, AW) in January but she's been expensive to follow otherwise, getting turned over at 3-1 or shorter five times; finished a close fourth with cheekpieces added at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) last week but that was a Class 5 and this is a deeper race; needs to find more.
runners.comment: Has been expensive to follow and she needs to find more on this step up in grade

runners.name: Bright Summer
runners.spotlight: Made it second-time lucky when winning a Lingfield novice (7f, AW) in May, but she's been disappointing in three runs since; took a strong hold in a York handicap (7f, good to firm) last time but she needs a major revival on this switch to sprinting.
runners.comment: Won AW novice in May but she's been disappointing since; needs to revive at this new trip

runners.name: Elara May
runners.spotlight: Constant progress last year saw her win four nurseries (5f, turf/AW) and she completed her season with a creditable fourth of 19 in a Listed event at the other Newmarket track (6f, good) in October; may have needed her reappearance run over C&D (good to firm) last month but that was a heavy defeat and she needs to find more progress to defy this mark.
runners.comment: Won four 5f nurseries last season but she reappeared with a heavy defeat over C&D

runners.name: Shallow
runners.spotlight: Struggled in Class 3 event at Glorious Goodwood three weeks ago, but she's a C&D winner who was runner-up here (6f, good to firm; first-time visor) on her penultimate run; has claims if she can recapture that form and her last three wins have been under George Wood.
runners.comment: Struggled at Glorious Goodwood but was runner-up over C&D on her penultimate run

runners.name: Adalida
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but she won at Lingfield (5f, good) in May and got back on the scoresheet with a narrow success at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) last month; well-held second over this trip at Lingfield last time, but she got hampered at the start and that was behind a big improver; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Won at Yarmouth before her second behind an improver at Lingfield last time; shortlisted

runners.name: Angel Shared
runners.spotlight: Often leads and her last three wins have been over C&D, including in this race last year; finished down the field in last four runs but this is a drop back in grade and she's now 7lb lower than for her last success; one to keep an eye on.
runners.comment: Won this off 7lb higher last year and she needs a close look on this drop back in grade

runners.name: Powdering
runners.spotlight: Versatile ground-wise and she recorded her ninth win when bouncing with a comfortable success over C&D (good to firm) in June; still looks feasibly treated on that form and she was a fair third in a Class 3 event back here last month; respected dropped back in grade.
runners.comment: Nine-time winner who scored over C&D in June and was a fair third here latest; respected

runners.name: Zighy
runners.spotlight: Two wins from three starts on AW and latest was off 6lb lower at Southwell (6f, AW) in April; 0-6 on turf but she made a bold bid at Chester (third of 11) last month and backed that up with a clear second at Ffos Las (5f, good) last time; this step back up in trip is a positive and she still has scope for further progress; key player.
runners.comment: Dual Tapeta winner who has run well on turf in her last two starts; key player
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

races.race_name: Racing TV Handicap

runners.name: Fanciulla Del West
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly who was a good second on handicap debut at Redcar (1m2f, good) in May; flopped when 3-1 favourite at Newbury (took keen hold) last month but she lost a shoe and it is still early days; big player if she can bounce back.
runners.comment: Flopped at Newbury latest but she's still unexposed is a player if she can bounce back

runners.name: Port Darwin
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he's won two of his last four starts including a last-gasp success at Brighton (1m2f, good to firm) two weeks ago; only 2lb higher here and he's a big player again if he can back that up.
runners.comment: Last-gasp winner at Brighton (1m2f) last time and he's a big player if he can back that up

runners.name: Emma's Letter
runners.spotlight: Added to her Newcastle novice last autumn when landing a Nottingham handicap (1m2f, good to firm) last month; held in third of four at Lingfield last time but that was a respectable effort in a tactical race and she should be in the mix again.
runners.comment: Won at Nottingham before a respectable effort in a tactical race at Lingfield; in the mix

runners.name: Miss Guinevere
runners.spotlight: Camelot filly who cost 65,000euros as a yearling; no impact at biggish prices in three novice/maiden events this season but this is more realistic and she needs watching in market upped in trip on handicap debut; hood reapplied.
runners.comment: Unexposed Camelot filly and she needs watching in market on handicap debut

runners.name: Liberate
runners.spotlight: Won a Goodwood novice (1m2f, good) for James Horton last May but she's generally struggled in handicaps since including in in Ireland this season; record is now 1-13 and she has something to prove for another new yard; cheekpieces worn last time are removed.
runners.comment: Record of 1-13 and she's generally struggled in handicaps; something to prove for new yard

races.race_name: End Of Summer Season Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Rizal
runners.spotlight: 0-7 in Ireland but he's been a big improver this season and made it 2-3 for George Scott when completing a double at Hamilton (1m4f, good to firm) last month; that was against two rivals but he won in decisive fashion and still looks feasibly treated off 5lb higher; strong contender in hat-trick bid.
runners.comment: Made it 2-3 for new yard when scoring in good style at Hamilton; big player again up 5lb

runners.name: Patrol
runners.spotlight: On same mark as when dead-heating at Southwell (1m4f, AW) last April but he's 0-15 since; finished runner-up in a big field at Newbury (1m4f, good) in May but he's hard to predict and was never involved at Ascot last time; comes with risks attached.
runners.comment: On workable mark but losing run is up to 15 and he's not easy to predict

runners.name: Parisian Scholar
runners.spotlight: 3yo who completed a double when landing a Class 4 handicap over C&D last month; well held in two quick-fire runs at Glorious Goodwood but he's back in calmer waters now and is a player if he can get back near best; acts on good to firm and good to soft.
runners.comment: Well held in two runs at Glorious Goodwood but he's not ruled out back in calmer waters

runners.name: Zurna
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fourth attempt when scoring under a prominent ride on handicap debut at Epsom (1m4f, good to firm) last month; up 6lb but that was a comfortable success and he's open to more progress over middle distances; respected.
runners.comment: Won on handicap debut at Epsom (1m4f) and he's open to more progress; respected

races.race_name: See You On The Rowley Mile Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Rogue Citation
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who added to her Southwell novice win when prevailing in a tight finish over C&D (good to firm) two weeks ago; up 3lb for that narrow success but that was a clear personal best and she showed a good attitude when it came to the crunch; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo who showed a good attitude when scoring over C&D last time; shortlisted

runners.name: Allegrino
runners.spotlight: Has been generally progressive in her eight starts and she got back on the scoresheet when landing a Yarmouth handicap (7f, good to firm) last month; another solid effort when second at Lingfield last time but this is a deeper race and she's more exposed than the other 3yos in this line-up; others preferred.
runners.comment: Has a solid record but she's starting to look exposed and others are more persuasive

runners.name: Hilltop
runners.spotlight: Reliable mare who won won at Newcastle (7f, AW) in March and has finished a close fourth at Lingfield and over C&D (good to firm) in her last two starts; this is competitive against some progressive 3yos but she's been as good as ever this year and should go well again.
runners.comment: Reliable mare who was a close fourth over C&D last time; should be in the mix again

runners.name: Splash
runners.spotlight: Made all for comfortable success in a Yarmouth maiden (7f, good to firm) last month but that was a five-runner race and she struggled in handicaps in her first two runs this season; still unexposed but she needs improvement to make a serious impact in this competitive event.
runners.comment: Made all in a Yarmouth maiden last time but this is much tougher back in a handicap

runners.name: Too Too Divine
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo who was awarded the race after being hampered in a Nottingham maiden (6f, good to firm) last month; needs to kick on again to defy this opening mark but she still has potential and this step back up in trip looks a good move.
runners.comment: Handicap newcomer who was awarded a Nottingham maiden latest; in the mix back up in trip

runners.name: Bami
runners.spotlight: Improved her record to 2-5 when reappearing with a 33-1 win in Newbury handicap (7f, good to firm) in June; 5lb higher after another break, but she held off a subsequent winner last time and is open to more progress; respected.
runners.comment: Made it 2-5 with a 33-1 win on her Newbury reappearance in June; respected up 5lb

runners.name: Miss Gallant
runners.spotlight: Made it second-time lucky with a narrow success in a Southwell novice (7f, AW; 6-1) last month; this is a different test on handicap/turf debut but she looks on a fair mark and is bred to be useful; one to keep an eye.
runners.comment: Twice-raced filly who won a Southwell novice (7f) last time; now makes handicap/turf debut

runners.name: Ironist
runners.spotlight: Now 2lb lower than for her Yarmouth win (6f, soft) last October but she's been out of sorts in last three runs and overall record is now 1-14; opposable.
runners.comment: Just one win from 14 starts and she's been out of sorts in last three runs; opposable

runners.name: Ghisa
runners.spotlight: Dual Tapeta winner for Ollie Pears last autumn; no impact in Dubai in first three runs for current yard but she's returned to Britain with two placed efforts on AW (6f/7f) this summer; still has a bit to prove on turf but she's 2lb lower than last time and needs watching in market back in this sphere.
runners.comment: Dual Tapeta winner who is unexposed on turf and is not ruled back in this sphere

races.race_name: Ascona Ladies Fuelled By Fashion Handicap

runners.name: Sixtygeesbaby
runners.spotlight: Not an instant success for new stable this season but won easily by 4l off much-reduced mark at Carlisle (5.8f, good) ten days ago and is 4lb ahead of the handicapper under 5lb penalty here; commands respect.
runners.comment: Won easily by 4l off much-reduced mark at Carlisle (5.8f) ten days ago; 4lb well in here

runners.name: Army Bugler
runners.spotlight: Won 5f maiden maiden last summer but ended his 2yo campaign with a disappointing effort and ran as though something was amiss on last month's reappearance; sports new cheekpieces for first attempt at 6f; needs to get career back on track.
runners.comment: Ran as though something was amiss on seasonal debut; cheekpieces on for first 6f attempt

runners.name: Alkuwarrior
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with clear win in first-time cheekpieces here (5f, good to soft) in early June but has not quite been at the same level on his three starts since and is not yet proven over 6f; goes without headgear today; needs to up his game.
runners.comment: 5f course winner in early June but not quite in same form since and not yet proven over 6f

runners.name: Pull The Rug
runners.spotlight: Denied clear run when fourth of six on last month's stable debut at Windsor and went close at Chepstow (also 6f, good to firm) two weeks ago, despite rider losing iron inside final furlong; gets another chance off same mark here; deserves a change of luck.
runners.comment: Started off for new stable with two good runs this summer, looking unlucky both times

runners.name: Safari Dream
runners.spotlight: Battled well to win from the front over C&D (good) 17 days ago, his second success this season; ought to give another good account but recent 2lb nudge could be enough to leave him vulnerable.
runners.comment: Battled well to win from the front over C&D this month; might be vulnerable off 2lb higher

runners.name: Liosa
runners.spotlight: Came good for current stable at third attempt, with fairly comfortable success at Ripon (6f, good) in June, and recovered from awkward start to take third off today's mark at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) last month; must be considered.
runners.comment: Won in good style in June and placed off new mark last month, despite awkward start

races.race_name: Ascona Ladies Chic Fashion Handicap

runners.name: Oviedo
runners.spotlight: Very useful over middle distances in his prime; had been in the doldrums for a good while but, having plummeted down the weights, breezed clear to win comfortably by 12l here (1m, good) nine days ago; 9lb well in under 5lb penalty today; ought to be hard to beat.
runners.comment: 9lb well in after breezing 12l clear over 1m here nine days ago; ought to be hard to beat

runners.name: Cypriot Diaspora
runners.spotlight: Won this race on good ground a year ago and followed up on soft ground over C&D a week later; not in same form this season but handicapped accordingly now and was placed over C&D (good) on last two outings; ought to make her presence felt again.
runners.comment: Won twice over C&D last August and was placed over C&D on last two outings; in the mix

runners.name: Ravenglass
runners.spotlight: Yet to win this season but went close at Chepstow (7f, good) in June and was denied a clear run before keeping on over that C&D last month; enters calculations.
runners.comment: Yet to win this season but went close at Chepstow in June; enters calculations

runners.name: Sofian
runners.spotlight: Now back on same mark as for narrow C&D (good) win just over a year ago but this season's record is unconvincing (last month's C&D third of four came in a tactical contest) and he refused to race here 17 days ago.
runners.comment: C&D winner last summer but refused to race here 17 days ago; others look safer

runners.name: Searchingtheblues
runners.spotlight: Placed twice off higher marks on AW this year but has become inconsistent and was soundly beaten on latest outing five weeks ago; also disappointed on only previous turf start (in May 2025); not an easy one to predict in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Placed twice off higher marks on AW this year but not easy to predict in new headgear

runners.name: Kaleidoscope Eyes
runners.spotlight: In good form over C&D this summer, most recently when keeping on well for narrow win on good ground 17 days ago; probably doesn't have much margin for error after 3lb rise but rain will aid her cause.
runners.comment: In good form over C&D this summer, most recently when keeping on well to win 17 days ago

runners.name: Green Icon
runners.spotlight: Regressive in Ireland over last two seasons and made nothing better than a mildly encouraging stable debut when midfield at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) last month; needs a boost from the refitted cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Made nothing better than mildly encouraging stable debut last month; cheekpieces refitted

races.race_name: Ascona Ladies In Lace Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Korbut
runners.spotlight: Runner-up all four starts this season, most recently when losing out only by a neck on handicap debut at Southwell (7f, AW) last month; should be fine back on turf and has another big role to play on these terms.
runners.comment: Went close on last month's handicap debut, her fourth consecutive second; big player again

runners.name: Likeness
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two nurseries (both 1m, AW) for George Boughey in the autumn but failed to build upon satisfactory reappearance run (7f) when well-held fifth of six in Southwell handicap (1m, AW) in April; makes stable debut (same owners) after 138-day break and with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Has the form to feature but absent since below-par run in April; new stable

runners.name: Reader
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut at Goodwood (6f, good) in October and probably didn't have race run to suit when third of four on reappearance outing at Pontefract (6f, good) in April; absent for another four months since and would be getting weight from her rivals if this was a handicap but is open to improvement over the new trip.
runners.comment: Would be getting weight from her rivals if this was a handicap but is unexposed over 7f

races.race_name: Ascona Ladies Fashion And Style Handicap

runners.name: Diamond Ali
runners.spotlight: Came good at ninth attempt, in what has turned out to be a good race for this grade at Windsor (1m, good to soft) in June; should be fine over this shorter trip and will be favoured by any rain; major player.
runners.comment: Narrow winner of what has turned out to be a good race for this grade at Windsor in June

runners.name: Willowinghurn
runners.spotlight: Northern raider who is yet to win this season but has slipped to a good mark and was persistently denied a clear run when midfield at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm; first-time visor) last week; rain will aid her cause and she can be dangerous if her luck improves.
runners.comment: Persistently denied clear run at Beverley last week; remains on a dangerous mark

runners.name: Arvana Belle
runners.spotlight: Seemingly back in good form when third to Gal at Leicester (7f, good to firm; first-time blinkers) last month but two lesser efforts have followed (1m/7f) and she now has questions to answer again; headgear removed.
runners.comment: Ran well in first-time blinkers last month but two lesser efforts have followed

runners.name: Iconic Dawn
runners.spotlight: Well down the field in her first three handicaps but ran well from the front when fourth in first-time blinkers over C&D (good) this month and has possibilities if the headgear continues to aid.
runners.comment: Seemingly aided by new blinkers when fourth over C&D this month; a possible

runners.name: Gal
runners.spotlight: Didn't fire on Polytrack ten days ago but pipped a dual subsequent winner when opening account at Leicester (7f, good to firm) last month and is not yet fully exposed over this sort of trip; contender if quickly back on song.
runners.comment: Below form on AW recently but pipped a dual subsequent winner at Leicester last month

runners.name: Cougar Force
runners.spotlight: Placed in both handicaps, more recently when running-on third at Lingfield (6f, good) in May; looks well worth another crack at a longer trip and features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: Ran on well for third over 6f at Lingfield in May; worth another crack at a longer trip

runners.name: Follow My Heart
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in her last three sprints, most recently when third at Salisbury (5f, good to firm) last month; unraced over 7f since low-key 2yo debut but stays 6f well and can feature if her stamina holds out.
runners.comment: Made the frame in her last three sprints; can feature if stamina holds out

runners.name: Medyg
runners.spotlight: Displayed clear promise on all three 2yo starts in the autumn but has been safely held in three handicaps this year (6f/1m); tried cheekpieces last time; blinkers are given a whirl here.
runners.comment: Quite promising as a 2yo but safely held in all three handicaps this year

runners.name: Kaiko
runners.spotlight: Showed no promise in her three qualifying races (5.7f-1m) and could be considered only if lively in the betting before this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Showed no promise in her three qualifying races (5.7f-1m); handicap debut today

runners.name: Independent Angel
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; gave good account when fourth over nearly 6f at Carlisle (soft) in June but did not get competitive at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago; back over this trip for first time since 2yo debut.
runners.comment: Ten-race maiden who did not get competitive at Chepstow recently; back up in trip

runners.name: Golden Mabel
runners.spotlight: Well beaten when last of six at Haydock (1m, good) this month and has now been unplaced all six starts; will appreciate this drop in grade but still can't be recommended.
runners.comment: Unplaced all six starts and can't be recommended

runners.name: Lady Fizz
runners.spotlight: Unexposed after only four runs and recent heavy defeat on handicap debut is best overlooked (became unsteerable after reins broke in early stages); needs to improve on her earlier form, though.
runners.comment: Remains unexposed and recent handicap debut is best overlooked; needs to improve, though

races.race_name: Ascona Fabulous Ladies Classified Stakes

runners.name: Typeface
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 1m here last summer and returns to Ffos Las after a respectable third of six in Leicester handicap (1m2f, good to firm) last month; yet to fully convince stamina-wise over this trip but helps to give Ian Williams a strong hand in this race; cheekpieces removed after one use.
runners.comment: Dual 1m course winner last summer; third in recent 1m2f handicap; probably on the premises

runners.name: Racing Demon
runners.spotlight: Went close in Chepstow handicap (1m, good; fine over 1m2f) in June and has strong form claims here if judged on that performance but this regressive and inconsistent 6yo is on a long losing run, and his habit of starting slowly is always a worry; sports first-time cheekpieces; risky.
runners.comment: Has the raw ability but this regressive and inconsistent 6yo often starts slowly; risky

runners.name: Charencey
runners.spotlight: Without a win since summer 2024 and nothing like the force of old but placed in this grade on last three appearances; drops back in trip after looking stretched by 1m4f last time; ought to be right in the thick of things.
runners.comment: Placed in this grade on last three outings and this drop back in trip will suit

runners.name: Gert Lush
runners.spotlight: Placed on three of her five starts since returning from long layoff this year, including C&D (good) handicap third two starts ago; likely to pose a potent threat in this basement grade.
runners.comment: Placed in C&D handicap last month and likely to pose a potent threat at this level
runners.owner: Mrs Muriel Forward & Dr G C Forward

runners.name: Lapidarist
runners.spotlight: A maiden after 14 starts but looked suited by step up to 1m2f when coming from the rear to go close in this grade at Lingfield (good to firm) three weeks ago and has each-way claims at least if in similar form.
runners.comment: 0-14 but went close in this grade at Lingfield when upped to 1m2f three weeks ago

runners.name: A Rose Adaay
runners.spotlight: 0-11 and has stamina to prove over this new trip but scores good marks for her consistency in handicaps at up to 1m this season; a possible.
runners.comment: Scores good marks for consistency at up to 1m this season; tries a new trip today

runners.name: Elora Prince
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced over 1m2f in this grade on last two starts but is yet to be placed after 14 starts and needs to find something extra on this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Not disgraced over 1m2f in this grade on last two starts but now 0-14

runners.name: King Of The Dance
runners.spotlight: Needs to rebound from a poor handicap run here nine days ago but is generally very consistent; came second in similar race to this over C&D (good) in June and probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Ran poorly last week but is generally very consistent; probably won't be far away

runners.name: City Escape
runners.spotlight: 0-5 for new stable this year; ran quite well when fifth of ten in Leicester handicap (1m2f, good to firm) last month but was soundly beaten at Chepstow three weeks later; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Ran quite well in Leicester handicap last month but soundly beaten since; others preferred

runners.name: Strong Man Tom
runners.spotlight: Yet to show any worthwhile form after six runs (two in bumpers), and was beaten about 28l when dropped to this grade at Chepstow (1m) last month; tries cheekpieces today.
runners.comment: Beaten about 28l when dropped to this grade at Chepstow (1m) last month

runners.name: Prophet Squeeze
runners.spotlight: Temperamental maiden who was a well-beaten 150-1 shot in this grade here (1m) last month, having lost many lengths at the start when reluctant to race (not for the first time).
runners.comment: Temperamental maiden who was a well-beaten 150-1 shot in this grade here (1m) last month

races.race_name: Ascona Ladies Race Day Elegance Handicap

runners.name: Buck Barrow
runners.spotlight: Just held on to pip Adrian in C&D (good to soft) classified in June and has finished third off today's mark in two subsequent C&D handicaps (both on good); has obvious each-way claims again.
runners.comment: Third in two C&D handicaps since narrowly winning C&D classified; obvious each-way claims
