runners.name: Cogital
runners.spotlight: Veteran who won over hurdles in June and ought to have finished second here (2m, good; rider dropped hands in closing stages) when back on the Flat later that month; may need further than 1m4f nowadays, though, and younger rivals appeal more.
runners.comment: Won over hurdles in June but may need further than 1m4f on the Flat nowadays

runners.name: Atalanta Mist
runners.spotlight: Close third in tactical race when upped to this trip at Chepstow (good to firm) last month and has now made the frame in her last four handicaps; could still have untapped potential over 1m4f; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Has made the frame in her last four handicaps and could still have potential over 1m4f

runners.name: Virtual Hug
runners.spotlight: Two wins this year, the latter off 1lb lower at Bath (11.6f, good) in May; behind Buck Barrow when fourth over C&D (good) last month but that certainly wasn't a bad run; no surprise if he features.
runners.comment: Two wins this year; behind Buck Barrow when fourth here last month; still considered
runners.owner: Mike Harris Racing & Nikki Evans Racing

runners.name: Dream Of Ithaca
runners.spotlight: Opened account at eighth attempt, with clearcut success in five-runner Brighton classified (1m4f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; that form isn't anything to get too excited about but the runner-up has won in that grade since and this filly might still have more to offer.
runners.comment: Clearcut winner of Brighton classified this month; could still have more to offer

runners.name: Saxophonic
runners.spotlight: A maiden after seven starts but would probably have preferred a stronger pace to aim at when keeping-on fourth at Southwell (1m3f, AW) last month; another 2lb lower here and has a fighting chance if first-time cheekpieces have positive effect.
runners.comment: Kept on for fourth at Southwell (1m3f, AW) last month; has claims if aided by cheekpieces

runners.name: Master Dancer
runners.spotlight: Regressive over hurdles; still lightly raced on the Flat and belied 40-1 odds when keeping on for third on handicap debut at Kempton (1m4f, AW) in May but has been well beaten twice since (11.6f/2m); now tried in a visor; not the percentage call.
runners.comment: 40-1 third on Flat handicap debut in May but well beaten twice since; now tries a visor

runners.name: Emerald Reine
runners.spotlight: Struggled when a big-priced outsider for three novice races in the spring (1m2f-1m3f) but remains unexposed and has more realistic chance to get competitive in this low-grade handicap; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Struggled in three novice races but has more realistic chance on this handicap debut

runners.name: Beau Chevalier
runners.spotlight: Well beaten off basement marks in first three handicaps (all over 1m in blinkers); not bred to benefit from this hike up in trip and needs massive improvement; no headgear today.
runners.comment: Well beaten off basement marks in first three handicaps (all over 1m in blinkers)

runners.name: Adrian
runners.spotlight: Far too inconsistent to rely upon heavily but lost out only narrowly to Buck Barrow when clear second in C&D classified (good to soft) in June and is 1lb better off with that rival today.
runners.comment: Too inconsistent to rely upon but was close second in C&D classified race on latest start

races.race_name: Why Settle Technology AI Adoption EBF Maiden Stakes (Hamilton 2Yo Series Qual') (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Pikachu
runners.spotlight: Posted a useful effort when third in Superlative Stakes at Newmarket (7f) in July and not disgraced with fourth of six in Vintage Stakes at Goodwood (7f) since; this son of Frankel should prove at least as effective over 1m; he's very much the one to beat back in maiden company.
runners.comment: In frame in Superlative at Newmarket and Vintage Stakes at Goodwood; he's the one to beat

runners.name: Nice Neasy Does It
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to 1m2f winner Wildcitydiva (RPR 57); dam, maiden from 7f-1m2f (60), is closely related to 1m 2yo winner Dancing Granny; the market can guide for this daughter of Nathaniel on her first run.
runners.comment: The market can guide for this daughter of Nathaniel on her debut

runners.name: Trumpety Trump
runners.spotlight: Shaped encouragingly when a debut third in 6f Ayr maiden but failed to build on it when fourth of five in 6f maiden here last month; this Churchill colt goes up in trip and retains potential, but improvement is needed.
runners.comment: Debut third at Ayr but failed to build on it when fourth here; more is needed up in trip

races.race_name: Huws Gray British Stallions EBF Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Wild Dahlia
runners.spotlight: Progressive 1m winner at two; off nine months/had wind surgery before returning with a promising third of seven in 1m handicap at Redcar 23 days ago, staying on well late; big shout off the same mark.
runners.comment: Made a promising return when third at Redcar; big shout off the same mark here

runners.name: Porth Eilian
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start in handicaps over 1m here in May and doubled her tally at Beverley (8.5f) in July; posted a solid third of five at Nottingham (1m) last month; very much one to consider with this slightly longer trip a likely plus.
runners.comment: Solid Nottingham third latest; very much one to consider over this slightly longer trip
runners.owner: Julie & David Martin, Dan Hall & Partner

runners.name: Thankfully
runners.spotlight: Landed 8.5f maiden at Beverley on her return in April but she hasn't kicked on in handicaps, only ninth of 12 at York (7f) 27 days ago; she needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Won at Beverley in April but hasn't kicked on in handicaps; needs to take big step forward
runners.owner: Mrs Tabor, Mrs Mv Magnier, Mrs Shanahan

runners.name: Saxon Grace
runners.spotlight: Much improved of late and she readily completed a quick hat-trick in 1m2f handicap at Ripon six days ago; shoulders a 12lb penalty here but she's still not taken lightly in her current mood.
runners.comment: Readily completed hat-trick at Ripon latest; shoulders 12lb penalty but not taken lightly

runners.name: Polygram
runners.spotlight: Gained a breakthrough success at Pontefract (1m) in July and backed it up with a good second of five in handicap at Ripon (1m2f) 18 days ago; a player off the same mark.
runners.comment: Good second of five in handicap at Ripon (1m2f) 18 days ago; a player off the same mark

runners.name: Krissy
runners.spotlight: Is enjoying an excellent season and notched a fourth success in 9f Musselburgh handicap in June; came in last of nine at Ayr (1m) last time but she's the sort to bounce back.
runners.comment: Fourth 2026 win at Musselburgh in June; last of nine at Ayr latest but sort to bounce back

runners.name: Foxy Night
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden who has made the frame on all her five runs, fitted with cheekpieces when a good third of ten in 7f Wolverhampton maiden three weeks ago; not out of things now stepping up in trip on her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Good third at Wolverhampton latest; not out of things up in trip on her handicap debut

runners.name: Second Fiddle
runners.spotlight: A six-time winner (including here) in 2025; back in good nick of late, third of nine in 1m handicap here ten days ago; in the mix off the same mark.
runners.comment: Back in good nick of late, third here ten days ago; in the mix off the same mark

runners.name: Sharona
runners.spotlight: A fair 7f winner for Peter Chapple-Hyam in 2023; lightly raced since and well held at York (1m2f) and over hurdles at Uttoxeter last summer; not easy to make a case for on her comeback run here.
runners.comment: Well held at York and over hurdles at Uttoxeter last summer; not easy to make a case for

races.race_name: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Lord d'Or
runners.spotlight: Palace Pier colt; fair form when runner-up on all his three starts this season, leading long way in nine-runner maiden at Windsor (1m2f) on latest occasion; holds very good form claims.
runners.comment: Runner-up all three starts this season, at Windsor last time; holds very good form claims
runners.owner: RC Syndicate X and Gary Gillies

runners.name: Nakassama
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful hurdles winner (at up to 2m6f) this summer who ran well very back on the Flat with fourth of 18 in 1m4f maiden at Galway 23 days ago; this Irish challenger is a player.
runners.comment: Hurdles winner this summer and good fourth back on Flat at Galway 23 days ago; a player

runners.name: Flagbearer
runners.spotlight: 5-1, hinted at promise when a never-dangerous fourth of eight in maiden at Ffos Las (1m, good) 17 days ago; this son of Sea The Stars fetched 485,000gns as a yearling and seems sure to do better, especially over this longer trip.
runners.comment: Hinted at promise with debut fourth at Ffos Las; sure to do better over this longer trip

races.race_name: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Tiernan
runners.spotlight: Showed some smart form without winning last year; was rated highly, but has been dropping to a better mark and is quite interesting back in handicap company, having broken his duck in good style in a 1m3f novice here last time.
runners.comment: Easy winner of a 1m3f novice here last time and quite interesting back in handicap company

runners.name: Elsass
runners.spotlight: Won first two races this year, the second a 1m3f handicap here by 5l (good); mixed form since (faced a stiff task last time); each-way chance.
runners.comment: Won first two races, one over 1m3f here, in the spring; mixed form since; each-way chance

runners.name: Yabher
runners.spotlight: Has won four of his 11 races, the latest by 6l at Goodwood in May (1m2f, good; made all); hit with a 12lb rise for that and below par since; stays 1m4f, has been dropped 4lb and tongue-tie now tried; bit to prove.
runners.comment: 4-11; easy Goodwood win off 8lb lower in May; below par since; tongue-tie now tried

runners.name: Salamanca City
runners.spotlight: In-form mare who is bidding for her fourth win this season, the third coming at Ripon last time when beating Spioradalta (now 4lb better off) by 1.5l; stays this trip well; on a career-high mark but the race should be run to suit her and she has a good chance.
runners.comment: Three wins from four runs this term, latest at Ripon (1m4f); career-high mark; contender

runners.name: Evanesco
runners.spotlight: Won a five-runner handicap at Newmarket in May (1m2f, good to firm) and fair runs since, last time finishing a close third at Goodwood (1m2f, good to firm); has won on testing ground; a possible on first try at 1m4f.
runners.comment: Versatile as regards ground, good third last time and may improve for the step up to 1m4f

runners.name: Letsbefrank
runners.spotlight: Tough sort; has won three times this season, the second over 1m3f here in May (good) and the latest a five-runner 2m1f Pontefract handicap on Sunday; has a penalty, but not ruled out.
runners.comment: Three wins this term, latest over 2m1f on Sunday; penalised, but not ruled out

runners.name: Noble Horizon
runners.spotlight: Ex-William Haggas; followed up his easy Leicester win in June (1m2f, good; made virtually all) by finishing runner-up off a 10lb higher mark at Goodwood last month; up another 3lb and tries 1m4f for the first time; interesting.
runners.comment: Ex-Haggas; easy Leicester win off 13lb lower in June; first try at 1m4f; interesting

runners.name: Spioradalta
runners.spotlight: Two wins over 1m2f at Ripon this year (good/good to soft) and a good second to Salamanca City (with whom he is 4lb better off) when stepped up to 1m4f there last time (good); won over 1m2f last September on only previous start here; interesting.
runners.comment: Interesting contender as he stays 1m4f, acts on the ground and won on his only start here

runners.name: Ashnak
runners.spotlight: Ex-French; only win was in a 1m1f conditions event on testing ground as a juvenile; has run a couple of fair races for David O'Meara this term, although was 20l seventh of ten at York last time (reportedly unsuited by the fast ground); could bounce back.
runners.comment: Heavy-ground winner in France; fair form for present yard and this slower ground will suit

runners.name: El Burhan
runners.spotlight: Four-time turf winner at up to 1m2f (good/good to soft), latest at Ayr last September; best of three runs this season when third at Southwell last time (1m3f); quite interesting on first try at 1m4f.
runners.comment: Four turf wins at up to 1m2f; decent AW third latest; interesting on first run at 1m4f

runners.name: Teumessias Fox
runners.spotlight: Four of his five wins have been on the AW, his only turf success coming at Newmarket in 2023 (1m4f, good); ran a couple of fair races on the AW earlier this year but pulled up in the Duke Of Edinburgh at Royal Ascot last time.
runners.comment: Best on AW (only turf win was in 2023); pulled up last time (Royal Ascot); bit to prove

runners.name: Lavender Hill Mob
runners.spotlight: Versatile 5yo whose latest win was a handicap hurdle at Cheltenham last November (2m5f, soft); hasn't been at his best on the Flat this year (2m-2m4f) although not beaten far in the Shergar Cup last time; not sure drop in trip will suit.
runners.comment: Last win was 2m5f handicap hurdle; below par on the Flat this year; 1m4f may be too sharp

runners.name: Altareq
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m2f at Ayr in July (good) and excuses for two heavy defeats since; can take a keen hold, so not sure to be suited by this step up to 1m4f.
runners.comment: Ayr winner in July (1m2f); excuses for two heavy defeats since; longer trip a concern

runners.name: Evaluation
runners.spotlight: Won four on the trot at 1m6f/2m for Charlie Johnston in 2022; has since won on AW and over hurdles; best watched on first run for Adam Nicol.
runners.comment: Four wins for Charlie Johnston in 2022; has since won on AW and over jumps; stable debut

runners.name: Strassia
runners.spotlight: Bought for 165,000euros in July last year having won twice in France, the second a 1m2f Listed event at Saint-Cloud; well below par on both starts for new yard last year (reportedly finished lame on second occasion); returns after a 330-day break with a hood tried; bit to prove.
runners.comment: 165,000euros purchase after two wins, one Listed, in France; back after 330-day break
runners.owner: Akela Thoroughbreds Ltd & Jinky Farms II

races.race_name: Acrisure Handicap

runners.name: Vantheman
runners.spotlight: Has done well since the blinkers went on but appears to have no margin for error off this mark, 2lb above his win in May; behind two of these here last time.
runners.comment: No margin for error off this mark and behind two of these here last time

runners.name: Tatterstall
runners.spotlight: Races prominently and he's not the only one, as was the case when a fader at Glorious Goodwood last time; had been in fair form previously but headgear is turned to and he wouldn't want the ground softer than good.
runners.comment: Running well prior to Goodwood; new headgear; wants the ground good or faster

runners.name: Eternal Sunshine
runners.spotlight: Without a win since last season's Portland handicap at Doncaster (good) off this very mark; races prominently and rallied for second here last time; clear claims, for all that she's one of a few who might want to be up there early.
runners.comment: Clear claims, for all that she's one of a few who might want to be up there early

runners.name: Canon's House
runners.spotlight: Four wins last season; on a competitive mark and under usual prominent tactics he hung around for a close fourth here 20 days ago; enters the reckoning.
runners.comment: Under usual prominent tactics he hung around for a close fourth here 20 days ago
runners.owner: M McHale, J Munroe, M Guy & D Walshe

runners.name: Justmyluck
runners.spotlight: Has not been in the best of form and can't afford to be 5lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Has not been in the best of form and can't afford to be 5lb out of the weights

runners.name: Advertised
runners.spotlight: Progressive as 2yo and started this year with a good 6f handicap run at Newmarket in April (good); lost his chance at the start next time but the York run last time is harder to forgive; fair mark if he could rediscover his best form.
runners.comment: Has not kicked on from an encouraging return but has a fair mark if back on song

runners.name: Oriental Prince
runners.spotlight: Most wins on the AW but able on turf and stayed on well for second here 20 days ago (good; might not prefer it softer); this is a better race but he'll appreciate chasing a strong pace if ground conditions are suitable; 2lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: This is tougher than when second last time but this race should be run to suit

runners.name: Parisiac
runners.spotlight: Made all over C&D in June and runner-up on his next two starts; below his best last time at Ayr but a revival would come as no surprise.
runners.comment: C&D winner; below his best last time at Ayr but a revival would come as no surprise

runners.name: Germanic
runners.spotlight: Best form has been on AW, with a career high at Newcastle in January (5f); 0-12 on grass and well down the field in a Class 2 at Glorious Goodwood latest.
runners.comment: Best form have been on the AW; down the field at Goodwood and now 0-12 on grass

runners.name: Sir Yoshi
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 4yo; has steadily found his form for current yard and wasn't disgraced at a higher level last time at Ascot; could go well as he handles any conditions.
runners.comment: Steadily found his form for current yard and wasn't disgraced at a higher level last time

runners.name: Sturlasson
runners.spotlight: Won three times last autumn (5f, AW/good to soft) and has run some solid races in defeat this year, including at Goodwood (soft) latest 75 days ago; a positive jockey booking and the recent rain was welcomed.
runners.comment: Capable sprinter off since June; good jockey booking and the recent rain was welcomed

runners.name: Stargazed
runners.spotlight: The second of 17 at the York Dante meeting (5f, good) is strong form but inferior efforts have followed, including when eighth in a big field back at York on Wednesday (in the first-time visor that's retained).
runners.comment: Recent struggles continued when eighth in a big field at York on Wednesday

runners.name: Jordan Electrics
runners.spotlight: Had first-time cheekpieces (retained) when making all at Ayr (5f, good to firm) a month ago for his first win in a while; put back up 4lb but still has handicapping scope if the headgear works again.
runners.comment: Up 4lb after recent win but still has handicapping scope if the headgear works again
runners.owner: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell

races.race_name: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Sir Garfield
runners.spotlight: Bagged a pair of 6f handicaps at Catterick and Epsom in early summer; comes here on the back of a very good nose second of eight in 6f Epsom handicap a week ago; another bold showing is on the cards off an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Very good nose second at Epsom week ago; another bold showing is on the cards

runners.name: Ashen
runners.spotlight: Gained a first success for current yard at Ayr (7f) in May and has proved reliable since, runner-up in 11-runner handicap at Musselburgh (7f) two weeks ago; he can go well again nudged up 1lb.
runners.comment: Proving reliable and runner-up at Musselburgh last time; can go well again nudged up 1lb

runners.name: Jannas Journey
runners.spotlight: Successful seven times (including over C&D) in 2025; back to winning ways at Carlisle (1m) in July but she went too freely when ninth of ten in 1m Ayr handicap 13 days ago; she's the sort to bounce back.
runners.comment: Won at Carlisle but too free when ninth at Ayr 13 days ago; she's the sort to bounce back

runners.name: Stirrup Cup
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Carlisle (6f) and not seen to ideal effect with fifth of eight over C&D later in June; this C&D scorer can't be discounted in refitted cheekpieces after a break.
runners.comment: Not seen to ideal effect with C&D fifth in June; this C&D scorer can't be discounted

runners.name: Lipsink
runners.spotlight: A four-time 5f/6f scorer in 2025; resumed from seven months off with an encouraging second of nine in 5f Sandown handicap in June; that form has worked out well, so this veteran is a likely player after another break.
runners.comment: Encouraging second at Sandown (form franked) in June; a likely player after another break

runners.name: Wreck It Ryley
runners.spotlight: Scored at Leicester (6f) in April; running well since and just edged out when third of 26 in 6f Goodwood handicap 23 days ago; that form is proving very strong, so he merits serious consideration despite 2lb rise.
runners.comment: Close third of 26 at Goodwood latest; form proving strong, so merits serious consideration

runners.name: Belsito
runners.spotlight: Gained a third C&D win in June and backed it up with a good third of 12 in 6f Southwell handicap 25 days ago; enters calculations once more.
runners.comment: Third C&D win in June and a good third at Southwell since; enters calculations once more

runners.name: Abduction
runners.spotlight: A dual 7f winner early in 2026 and he's holding his form well, beaten a nose when second of five in 7f Ayr handicap 25 days ago; this C&D scorer can make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Holding his form well this term; this C&D scorer can make his presence felt

runners.name: Hunky Dory
runners.spotlight: A fair 6f winner at Wolverhampton this spring for Jack Morland; not discredited for his new handler with third of 11 in 7f claimer at Carlisle two days ago; no forlorn hope.
runners.comment: Not discredited for new handler with third at Carlisle two days ago; no forlorn hope

runners.name: Whiskey Kisses
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but she was placed for the third start in a row when second of 13 in 6f Ayr handicap 13 days ago; not out of things off just a 1lb higher mark.
runners.comment: 0-11 but a good second at Ayr 13 days ago; not out of things off 1lb higher mark

runners.name: Shoot To Kill
runners.spotlight: On a losing run but this Irish challenger arrives in good nick, not best drawn when sixth of 15 in 7f Galway handicap 24 days ago; in the mix again.
runners.comment: On a losing run but in good nick, not best drawn when sixth at Galway latest; in the mix

races.race_name: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Dandy Magic
runners.spotlight: Several creditable efforts this summer before getting back on the scoresheet with a strong finish over C&D (good; second-time cheekpieces) last week; this is tougher under a penalty but that was a personal best last time and she should get a good tow into this race; respected.
runners.comment: Got back on the scoresheet with strong finish over C&D last week; respected under penalty

runners.name: They All Know Me
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt when coming from rear to land a Carlisle handicap (7f, soft) in May; only 1lb higher here but he's been well held in his last two starts and this is his first attempt at a sprint trip; others preferred.
runners.comment: Well held in both runs since his Carlisle win and he's untried at this trip; down the list

runners.name: Winged Messenger
runners.spotlight: Four-time sprint winner who is ideally suited by good or slower ground; finished down the field in last two starts, but he ran well at Redcar in May and is now back on the same mark as when landing the Ayr Bronze Cup (6f, soft) last autumn; needs a close look back from a short break.
runners.comment: Defied this mark in Ayr Bronze Cup last autumn; not ruled after a short break

runners.name: Montezuma
runners.spotlight: Beat 16 rivals when scoring from off the pace at Musselburgh (5f, good to soft) in April; three placed efforts since but he flopped when favourite at Musselburgh last time and that took his record to 1-16; comes with risks attached back up in trip.
runners.comment: Record of 1-16 and he flopped when favourite at Musselburgh last time; risks attached
runners.owner: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell

runners.name: Iris Dancer
runners.spotlight: 12-time C&D winner including three this summer; no impact in her last three starts, but her last success was off only 1lb lower and she battled well when landing this race last year; not ruled out.
runners.comment: 12-time C&D winner including in this race last year; not ruled out off workable mark

runners.name: Daizen
runners.spotlight: Returned to form when making all at Thirsk (6f, good) in June but he failed to back that up in a Silver Cup trial at Ayr last month; that was another blip in his patchy profile and he needs to bounce back again.
runners.comment: 3yo who won at Thirsk in June but he's hard to predict and was well held last time

runners.name: Miraculous
runners.spotlight: Ended lengthy losing run when scoring off reduced mark at Southwell (6f, AW) two weeks ago; back up 5lb but he remains well treated on his best form including a win at Chester (6f, good) last July; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Cashed in on reduced mark at Southwell and he remains well treated on old form; key player

runners.name: City Captain
runners.spotlight: Acts on good and soft ground; record of 4-15 and his wins were in handicaps last season, including over C&D; still 8lb higher than for his last success but he was runner-up at Thirsk in April and did best of the pacesetters when fourth at Haydock (7f, good) last time; returns after a break and he's in the mix on this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Acts on good and soft ground; C&D winner and he's in the mix back in trip after a break

runners.name: Lord Bertie
runners.spotlight: His wins have come on slow ground but he was beaten only 3l in a big field at York (7f, good to firm) last month; that was a creditable effort after a slow start and he ran well over this trip at Ayr on his penultimate run; could be dangerous.
runners.comment: Creditable efforts over 6f and 7f in his last two starts; could be dangerous back in trip

runners.name: Wobwobwob
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on his old form but last win was over two years ago and he's been out of sorts this season; this drop back in trip is no problem but he needs a major revival; visor reapplied.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on old form but last win was in 2024 and he's struggled this season

races.race_name: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap

runners.name: Tanjen
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark on turf with a decisive win in a C&D apprentice event last week (good); put up 6lb for that, but able to run off the same mark here; the one to beat.
runners.comment: Easy win in C&D apprentice event last week; escapes a penalty; 6lb well in;  one to beat

runners.name: Startling
runners.spotlight: Four AW wins, but 0-9 on turf; some sound efforts recently, notably when second with blinkers tried at Ayr last time (5f, good); each-way chance.
runners.comment: Four AW wins, but 0-9 on turf; fine second with blinkers tried last time; each-way chance

runners.name: Hi Lord
runners.spotlight: Mixed form since C&D win in May (good); better than his last run (carried left at the start), but others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Mixed form since C&D win in May; excuses for poor run latest, but others appeal more

runners.name: Thistle Nil
runners.spotlight: Won an Ayr maiden at 200-1 in June (6f, soft), but has been well beaten in two handicaps since.
runners.comment: Won Ayr maiden at 200-1 in June (6f, soft); well beaten in two handicaps since.

runners.name: Falcon Queen
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; eight-race maiden; fair run when fourth at Ayr last time (5f, good) in a race in which Startling was 2.5l in front of her in second; fairly unexposed and could turn that form around.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish; 0-8; fair fourth at Ayr last time when Startling was second; could go well

runners.name: Doon The Glen
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been over 6f here, the first on good to soft in June, the second on good to firm last month; effective at 5f, but not been in quite such good form recently.
runners.comment: Both wins gained over 6f here, the second last month; effective at 5f, but not in top form

runners.name: King Of The Jungle
runners.spotlight: Bids for a hat-trick after wins at Beverley in May (5f, good to firm) and Ayr in June (5f, soft); up 11lb (5lb rise for last win); each-way chance.
runners.comment: Bids for hat-trick after wins at Beverley and Ayr but up 11lb and is on a career-high mark

runners.name: Supremissy
runners.spotlight: Unexposed; 28-1 winner on handicap debut at Musselburgh in June (5f, good), but well beaten at Ayr next time (plenty to find with Startling on that run).
runners.comment: 28-1 winner on h'cap debut at Musselburgh in June, but well beaten only run since

runners.name: Jm Jhingree
runners.spotlight: Gained the second of his two C&D wins in June when wearing cheekpieces for the first time (good); well beaten last two starts, but blinkers didn't work on first occasion and he didn't stay 6f at Catterick on Monday; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins, latest with cheekpieces in June; didn't stay 6f last time; should do better

runners.name: Kyber Crystal
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in September 2024 (good to soft); two wins in 2025, but hasn't shown her best form so far this term; on a good mark as a result, so not out of it.
runners.comment: C&D winner in 2024; not been in top form this year, but on a good mark now; could go well

runners.name: Harb
runners.spotlight: Exposed sort; 2lb lower than when winning at Carlisle in March (5f, good) but wasn't at his best at Ayr last time.
runners.comment: Exposed; 2lb lower than Carlisle win in May, but wasn't at his best at Ayr last time

runners.name: Impressor
runners.spotlight: Three wins here, two over this trip, the other over 6f; well beaten when returning from a break last time; not out of it in first-time visor, but ideally needs soft/heavy ground.
runners.comment: Three wins here (5f/6f); could go well with new headgear, but best on soft/heavy ground

runners.name: Never Dark
runners.spotlight: Has won nine races, two over C&D (good to soft/soft); 3.5l second to Tanjen over C&D last time but meets her on the same terms, so may struggle to turn that form around.
runners.comment: Nine wins, two over C&D; 3.5l second to Tanjen over C&D last time, but on same terms here

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Seaxburh
runners.spotlight: Finished ahead of Belicoso when second at Down Royal last month; placed twice again since and has built up some good experience; form of latest Galway effort looks solid; step up in trip should suit; Browne McMonagle prefers Belicoso but not much in it.
runners.comment: Maiden, placed last three times; step up in trip to suit; stable jockey prefers Belicoso

runners.name: Old Joanie
runners.spotlight: Beaten between 8 and 12l in three decent maidens on good ground; shaped as if in need of further and bred to get it so makes some each-way appeal now in handicaps; tongue-tie on.
runners.comment: Shaped as if in need of further in three 7f runs; makes some appeal now up to 1m

runners.name: Maggie Walker
runners.spotlight: Landed a Cork auction maiden on debut over 6f on soft; beat Hanney Boy by 2l and he's been placed in Listed company since; last of 6 in Group 2 since on quicker ground; dam a winner over 12f so step up in trip could unlock further improvement and she looks on a exploitable mark.
runners.comment: Maiden winner, beat Hanney Boy; last of 6 in G2 on quicker; on a nice mark up in trip

runners.name: Razmataz
runners.spotlight: Well-held and slowly into stride on each of his three starts; step up in trip and gelding operation needs to sharpen him up; opening mark doesn't look too generous.
runners.comment: Well-held on all three starts, slowly into stride each time; gelded; opening mark tough

runners.name: Margot Mae
runners.spotlight: Standout effort on second start when beaten 1l in Leopardstown maiden (7f soft) in June, split two smart Ballydoyle fillies; step backwards over same C&D last time; steps up in trip and would look well treated on best run if bouncing back.
runners.comment: Standout run at Leopardstown in June; step backwards over same C&D lto; up in trip

runners.name: Elyatta
runners.spotlight: Couldn't get involved in three maiden runs from 6f to 7f; opening mark doesn't look too lenient so needs step up in trip to make a significant difference; first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Unable to get involved three maidens over shorter; needs step up to bring improvement

runners.name: Belicoso
runners.spotlight: Improved on first two runs to be beaten 2l stepped up to 7f at Down Royal (good) 35 days ago; form has held up (fourth won maiden since) ; step up in trip could bring about improvement but needs to off this opening mark; stable first-string.
runners.comment: Improved stepped up to 7f lto, form solid; step up in trip needs to bring improvement

runners.name: Fine Line
runners.spotlight: Huge prices on three maiden starts and ran accordingly; didn't fare much better albeit stayed on reasonably well on nursery debut when beaten 7.25l into seventh at Sligo 16 days ago; back up in trip now and mark probably too high.
runners.comment: Well-held in three maidens and Sligo nursery; up in trip; mark probably too high

races.race_name: CSG Rated Race

runners.name: Mayflower
runners.spotlight: Debut juvenile winner at Leopardstown; started the season with two Group 3 runs at Curragh, not at all disgraced; however, she has been well beaten in two handicaps; others preferred as a consequence.
runners.comment: Started the season with two Group 3 runs, well beaten in two handicaps, others preferred

runners.name: Iamimmaculate
runners.spotlight: Claimed after Naas success last September; pleasing yard debut when second in Leopardstown nursery; seemingly ridden to stay 1m2f trip on return at Roscommon in late June, staying on into fourth; did not get the best of runs when well supported at Galway; tongue-tie on now, leading chance.
runners.comment: Won a claimer last year, twice second in handicaps, tongue-tie on now, leading chance

runners.name: Manton Bay
runners.spotlight: Won an AW maiden over this trip last winter; good form on first two starts this term on turf, over 1m at Naas and 1m2f at Navan; not as good at the Curragh next time; beaten favourite for a second time when second over 1m at Leopardstown; has achieved a fair standard all the same.
runners.comment: Twice a beaten favourite in handicaps this term, has achieved a fair standard all the same

runners.name: Elmakaya
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett filly made some late headway on debut at Leopardstown; perhaps a little unlucky not to peg back a front-running Totally Puzzle at Naas in May; confirmed maiden-winning potential with third of 19 at the same venue; not quite as good at Gowran last time.
runners.comment: Has made the frame in three maidens over this trip, capable of making her presence felt
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Kirkland Sioux
runners.spotlight: Took a massive rise in the ratings (23lb) for back-to-back wins at Fairyhouse and the Curragh in July, showing a liking for quick ground; struggled in her hat-trick bid on easier going at Galway.
runners.comment: Struggled at Galway bidding for a hat-trick, possibly too high after going up 23lb

runners.name: Totally Puzzled
runners.spotlight: Dismal effort on seasonal debut over 1m2f on soft-to-heavy at the Curragh; transformed when beating Elmakaya over 1m on good ground at Naas in May; slightly concerning that she has not run since then, while the runner-up has garnered more experience.
runners.comment: Dismal effort on seasonal debut, transformed when beating Elmakaya at Naas in May

runners.name: Oscar Nominee
runners.spotlight: Frankel filly; promising in two AW runs in Britain last winter; stays further than this; rating seems fair enough
runners.comment: Frankel filly, promising in two AW runs in Britain last winter, stays further than this

runners.name: Do For Love
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m on AW in France in February; unplaced in two subsequent races; best watched on Irish debut.
runners.comment: Won over 1m on AW in France in February, unplaced in two subsequent races, best watched
runners.owner: David K Kelly & Mrs Pauline Condon

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Carolina Jetstream
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner but has bettered that form on turf this year when second in Group 2 at the Curragh (1m, good) and beaten 5.5l in Duke Of Cambridge; step up in trip didn't suit in Pretty Polly last time; front-runner and dangerous if allowed dictate.
runners.comment: Bettered very useful AW form on turf with second in G2 and good run at Ascot; big chance
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

runners.name: Hardy Warrior
runners.spotlight: Smart form as a 2yo, bolted up in Leopardstown maiden (1m, yielding/soft) before 5l second to Benvenuto Cellini in Group 2; opened season with easy conditions race win at Naas (1m, soft) and decent efforts in defeat since; fourth at Galway 24 days ago a solid effort in first-time cheekpieces but needs to reverse form with Jagged Edge off same terms; tongue-tie goes on.
runners.comment: Smart 2yo; won Naas conditions race on soft this year; Galway run lto puts him bang there

runners.name: East Hampton
runners.spotlight: Not won since his Madrid Handicap success 18 months ago at Naas (7f, soft) but has run some fine races, most notably when second to Diego Velazquez on good at the Curragh last year and filled the same spot behind Big Gossey on soft in the Gladness in March; well below form last time on firm; highest-rated in the field but may need ground to soften up before he's at his best.
runners.comment: Best run this year second in Gladness on soft; highest-rated but quick ground a negative

runners.name: Jagged Edge
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over 1m on varying ground; ran to best when beaten 2l in Galway handicap last month; wide trip at same venue 19 days ago; should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Three-time 1m winner on varying ground; ran to best at Galway; should be thereabouts

runners.name: Wearing Stars
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has ran solid races over a variety of trips but likely to be found wanting at this level; yard won this last year.
runners.comment: Consistent nine-race maiden; likely to be found wanting at this level

runners.name: Syzygy
runners.spotlight: Three-time handicap winner on testing ground over 1m to 1m2f last year; clear career-best when second to subsequent Group 3-winning stablemate in Listed race at Navan (1m, good); close to matching that effort when beaten 7l into fourth in Meld Stakes 36 days ago; strong pace in front would help and each-way chance.
runners.comment: Three-time winner on testing ground; career-best in Listed in June; strong pace would help

runners.name: Rion Rubette
runners.spotlight: Three-time handicap winner over 7f; career-best 14 days ago when second to Rebel Wave giving away 15lb; up against it in this company however and ran to freely on last attempt at 1m.
runners.comment: Three-time h'cap winner over 7f; career-best, second off 88 14 days ago; this much tougher

runners.name: Moonlit Sun
runners.spotlight: Third in strong maiden at Naas (1m, good) before going two places better over same C&D, defeating White Sand Beach by 1l; not seen to best effect when beaten 1l into fourth on handicap debut at Galway but still needs a plenty more at this level.
runners.comment: Naas maiden winner; not seen to best effect on h'cap debut lto but plenty more needed here

runners.name: Quebec
runners.spotlight: Has some good Group form in Germany and ran okay on Irish debut when beaten 5l in Leopardstown Group 2; detached last at the Curragh last time, however, so hard to have confidence in.
runners.comment: Good Group form in Germany; decent Irish debut at Leop but detached last at Curragh since

runners.name: Subsonic
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m2f Curragh maiden in September (yielding to soft) before good third in Listed event at Gowran Park (9.5f, good); consistent but well-held in three stakes races since; down in trip and needs more.
runners.comment: Has been consistent in stakes races this year but hasn't threatened a win; down in trip

runners.name: Cristal Clere
runners.spotlight: Best form has come on ground with a give, landed Listed contest over this trip at Listowel in September in testing conditions; beaten 13l at this grade over 1m4f at Limerick 63 days ago; drop in trip fine but up probably up against it on good ground.
runners.comment: Listed winner on heavy in September; decent run at Limerick 63 days ago; needs rain

races.race_name: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap

runners.name: Chutzpal
runners.spotlight: Won this last year off 4lb lower; some good runs since and ran a solid race when beaten 2.25l into sixth over 1m7f at Leopardstown 15 days ago; 2-4 here so has to enter calculations.
runners.comment: Won this last year off 4lb lower; shaped as if still in form lto; can't dismiss

runners.name: Immutable
runners.spotlight: All four wins, three on Flat and one over hurdles, came on soft; finished runner-up last twice in Cork Derby and competitive Galway handicap; obvious claims up in trip but might need rain before he gets his head in front again.
runners.comment: Shaping as if turn near again in competitive h'caps; quick ground slight worry; up in trip

runners.name: Factual Fact
runners.spotlight: Progressive on the Flat, landed qualified riders handicap over 2m1f here in May off 8lb lower, travelling powerfully; followed up with 1.5l second at the Curragh over this trip (Granite Bay third); found consistency come to an end but ran to bad to be true at the Curragh 54 days ago; freshened up since and big chance if can resume progress.
runners.comment: Couse winner good run came to end at Curragh 54 days ago; leading player if bouncing back

runners.name: Sir Jeremy
runners.spotlight: Did well to gain third win when powering home to get up by a neck at Galway (1m4f, yielding) 20 days ago; up 5lb but this trip could suit on that evidence.
runners.comment: Landed 1m4f Galway h'cap off 5lb lower 20 days ago, race set up well; 5lb higher

runners.name: Eagle Fang
runners.spotlight: 145-rated staying hurdle, runner-up in two valuable handicaps at Aintree and Haydock in spring; second behind Gaoth Chuil in Flat maiden at Leopardstown before going one better over C&D last month; cracking handicap debut when beaten 2l in competitive race at Galway 25 days ago; 2lb rise fair and very much unexposed in this sphere.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner last month; cracking h'cap debut when fourth at Galway; big chance

runners.name: The Real Screamer
runners.spotlight: Five-time handicap winner, three on AW; latest win at Leopardstown (1m4f, good) off 7lb lower in May followed up with good run at the Curragh; always behind at Galway last time and tries new trip.
runners.comment: Five-time h'cap winner, latest at Leop in May; never a factor at Galway and tries new trip

runners.name: Gaoth Chuil
runners.spotlight: Very useful hurdler and course winner on the Flat here in 2m1f handicap off 5lb lower last month, following up Leopardstown (1m7f, good-to-firm) victory over Eagle Fang; meets that rival on better terms but has to put tame effort at Galway behind her.
runners.comment: Versatile course winner over 2m1f; weakened tamely at Galway lto; bounce back needed

runners.name: Light Up The Dark
runners.spotlight: Listed bumper winner; landed 1m5f Flat maiden at Down Royal last year on good; decisively scored at Gowran Park over this tirp on soft in April and didn't get the cleanest of runs at Galway last time; may need a slight ease in the ground to show best.
runners.comment: Won over this trip on soft in April; ran with credit twice since but quick ground concern

runners.name: Granite Bay
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner not got head in front in nearly two years but has been very consistent; faded when beaten favourite into seventh at Galway (2m1f, yielding) 25 days ago but drop back to this trip should aid his cause; contender in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Consistent; faded over 2m1f at Galway lto; drop back in trip to suit; contender

runners.name: Luker's Tipple
runners.spotlight: Finally got head in front after 19 attempts when landing Downpatrick maiden hurdle last month and has since followed it up with a novice hurdle and chase victory; needs to prove as effective on the Flat but didn't run badly in 1m3f maiden in April on ground softer than ideal; could be on a decent mark.
runners.comment: In excellent form over obstacles; needs to prove as effective on Flat but on a nice mark

runners.name: Royal Hollow
runners.spotlight: Versatile mare who landed a C&D maiden a year ago; good form this year, ran a cracker when second to Deressa off 4lb lower at Ballinrobe in June; Galway Hurdle run can be ignored and holds each-way chance.
runners.comment: Versatile C&D maiden winner last year; big run off 4lb lower in June; ew chance

runners.name: Taipan
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner, including over C&D in 2023; returned to something close to beat when beaten a nose at Galway in conditions race on yielding 21 days ago; raised 5lb and mark is plenty high back in a handicap.
runners.comment: C&D winner returned to form when just edged out over this trip lto; mark plenty high

runners.name: War Rooms
runners.spotlight: Gained first win since 2023 with good attitude shown at Ballinrobe (1m5f, good) 32 days ago, defeating Truth Be Told by a neck; raised 6lb and probably not guaranteed to back that up but did run well over C&D last year.
runners.comment: Good attitude gaining second win at Ballinrobe lto; 6lb higher; ran well over C&D before

races.race_name: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Lady Plimsoll
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in Ballinrobe (9.5f, good) claimer last summer; never out of the three in last four handicap starts over a variety of trips; appreciated return to good ground when beaten 1.5l by Fianna three days ago at Roscommon; extra two furlongs no problem and big chance if backing up quickly.
runners.comment: Appreciated return to good ground when second three days ago; can go close if backing up
runners.owner: Athlumney Farms Ltd & Eoin Baxter & Mrs M D O'Callaghan

runners.name: Trubshaw
runners.spotlight: Won twice last year, including 1m6f Curragh handicap off 3lb lower in October; has found revised mark beyond him so far this year; blinkers tried.
runners.comment: Curragh winner over this trip last year; has found revised mark tough; blinkers tried

runners.name: Chicago Moon
runners.spotlight: Improved switched to handicaps, shaped well here over 1m3f in May before scoring over same C&D 39 days ago, beating Canon Law by 2.5l, who has won since; 9lb higher and longer trip to contend with but leading claims.
runners.comment: Off mark with cosy win here 39 days ago, second won since; leading player off 9lb higher
runners.owner: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit

runners.name: Desert Friend
runners.spotlight: Veteran who has scored four times on the turf; latest at Sligo (1m6f, soft) in May off 3lb lower; bit to find with some of these rivals based on Bellewstown run last month and would prefer rain.
runners.comment: Nine-time winner, mark may be too high based on recent efforts; best on ground with ease

runners.name: Espritroyale
runners.spotlight: Steadily improved for handicaps and appreciated ease in the ground last twice when runner-up at Down Royal (1m2f) and Galway (1m6f); well-held both times but was behind very well-handicapped winner at Galway and finished 2.75l ahead of Lady Pimsoll; considered but probably best on ground with a give.
runners.comment: Steadily improved in h'caps; distant second at Galway to well-treated winner; considered

runners.name: Celestially
runners.spotlight: Has been getting the hang of things in handicaps and is closely matched with a few main rivals based on third at Bellewstown off 5lb lower last month; followed that up with good second over C&D last time and is one of the lesser exposed types in here; likely player.
runners.comment: Not much to find with Numidia on Bellewstown run; solid second over C&D lto; likely player

runners.name: Jurality
runners.spotlight: Winner over 1m5f at Navan (good) in June off 11lb lower; followed up with narrow defeat at Bellewstown (split Numidia and Celestially); obvious chance on that form but folded tamely at Leopardstown 29 days ago.
runners.comment: Winner over 1m5f at Navan in June; couple of good runs since but faded tamely lto

runners.name: Charlie Brow'n
runners.spotlight: Sole success came over this trip on soft ground at Navan in October; solid efforts either side of hurdles run; ground may be too quick.
runners.comment: Winner over 1m6f (soft) at Navan off 6lb lower in Oct; ground unlikely to suit

runners.name: Queen Of Astolat
runners.spotlight: 0-6 in Britain; well-held on stable debut at Sligo 16 days ago; dropped 4lb but 2lb wrong at the weights here so she has plenty on her plate.
runners.comment: 0-6 in Britain and well-held on stable debut 16 days ago; dropped 4lb and 2lb wrong

runners.name: Numidia
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner, landed successive handicaps at Bellewstown (1m6f) and Down Royal (1m5f, good); 6lb rise and muddling pace found him out at Gowran Park last time; extra distance will help and he can bounce back.
runners.comment: Successive h'cap wins during summer but too keen at Gowran lto; can bounce back

races.race_name: HR Buddy (Q.R.) Race

runners.name: Samui
runners.spotlight: Smart dual-purpose sort; well suited by the race conditions; twice ran well in defeat at Royal Ascot last summer, third in the Copper Horse Handicap (1m6f, good to firm) and second in the Queen Alexandra (2m5f, good to firm); not seen since a fine second in a 1m6f Group 3 at York 13 months ago; good opportunity for Hannah Smullen if he returns in prime shape.
runners.comment: Has been off for 13 months, versatile sort, clearly superior to these if fully tuned

runners.name: Ragmans Corner
runners.spotlight: Better known as a smart four-time hurdles winner; good recent form when fourth in the Galway Hurdle off a mark of 132, roughly the same ability as Samui; also a capable Flat performer but his 81 rating makes him 23lb inferior to Samui in this sphere.
runners.comment: Better known as a smart hurdler, fourth in Galway Hurdle, also a capable Flat performer

runners.name: Can Happen
runners.spotlight: Handicap hurdle winner on debut for this yard at Ballinrobe in May; made a pleasing Flat debut when a strong-finishing second to an odds-on shot in a 1m4f Bellewstown amateur riders' event early last month; finished in mid-field in a handicap hurdle at Galway.
runners.comment: Finished well for second to an odds-on shot in a 1m4f Bellewstown amateur riders' event
runners.owner: Michael J Mulligan & Patrick G Walsh

runners.name: Murat
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in two bumpers; fair novice hurdler last season; stylish winner of a 1m7f maiden at Leopardstown last month on his second Flat start; plenty to find with Samui on figures, but has potential to improve his rating and is race-fit
runners.comment: Unbeaten in two bumpers, fair novice hurdler last season, stylish winner at Leopardstown

runners.name: Glowing Account
runners.spotlight: Smart Flat pedigree; looked good when justifying short odds on debut in Listowel bumper in September 2023 (good); failed to build on that twice afterwards on softer ground; absent from December 2023 until tailed off in a 1m4f maiden at the Galway festival.
runners.comment: Absent from December 2023 until tailed off in a 1m4f maiden at Galway, best watched

runners.name: Silas Marner
runners.spotlight: Showed early promise in bumpers; has never delivered on that; tailed off twice recently.
runners.comment: Showed early promise in bumpers, has never delivered on that, tailed off twice recently

runners.name: Supreme Law
runners.spotlight: Low-rated gelding with poor handicap form; no apparent chance.
runners.comment: Low-rated gelding with poor handicap form, no apparent chance

runners.name: Simpletwistoffaith
runners.spotlight: Placed once from 17 starts over hurdles, weak Flat form, can be left out of calculations
runners.comment: Placed once from 17 starts over hurdles, weak Flat form, can be left out of calculations

races.race_name: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On 29th August Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Kimi De Mai
runners.spotlight: Three-time French bumper winner should win if she runs to her official rating of 117 but that was the thinking at Cork (2m3f, yielding) in April when sent off the 4-7 favourite and she finished tailed off; again tailed off in a Galway handicap hurdle last time; could bomb out or could win in a canter.
runners.comment: Tailed off in last two starts but on her rating could win in a canter

runners.name: First Ascent
runners.spotlight: Touched off in a Down Royal Flat maiden last year (1m3f, good); made a mistake at two out when a 6.5l fourth at Ballinrobe last month (2m2f, good); runner-up over C&D last time when hampered by a faller at the last but it likely would merely have reduced the 14l winning margin; needs to progress.
runners.comment: C&D runner-up last time but needs to show progression

runners.name: Mistakenforanother
runners.spotlight: Best of four bumper runs came over 2m here in June when runner-up to a subsequent maiden hurdle winner; below best at Killarney last time; hurdles need to bring improvement.
runners.comment: Best of four bumper runs came here when runner-up; hurdles need to bring more

runners.name: Rene's Gold
runners.spotlight: Not much promise in two points but wasn't too bad on her rules bow at Galway when returning from over a year off to finish eighth of 19 (2m1f, good to yielding); place chance if building on it.
runners.comment: Poor in two points but okay rules bow at Galway after over a year off; place chance

runners.name: Rickety Kate
runners.spotlight: First reserve; by Order Of St George; dam 2m3f chase winner, half-sister to useful bumper and 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner Lust For Glory, out of unraced half-sister to useful 2m4f hurdle winner Theatre Bird; check market.
runners.comment: Reserve; by Order Of St George; dam 2m3f chase winner; check market

runners.name: Geashill Poet
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; third foal; dam unplaced 6f-10.6f (RPR 29), half-sister to 7f 2yo winner Randall's Alannah, out of 2m hurdle winner; best watched
runners.comment: Reserve; dam unplaced 6f-10.6f (RPR 29); best watched

runners.name: Loadstone
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; half-brother to 2m/2m2f hurdle winner Shaboozee; dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Duhallow Gesture (bumper/2m1f hurdle) and Me And Ben (2m4f-3m hurdle/chase), out of unraced half-sister to high-class jumper Rhinestone Cowboy; market best guide.
runners.comment: Reserve; half-brother to 2m/2m2f hurdle winner Shaboozee; market best guide

runners.name: Baila Conmigo
runners.spotlight: Recorded a third AW win in July; didn't run badly at Galway over 1m4f (yielding to soft) and his lesser effort there next time is likely explained by the fact it came a day later; hood on for hurdling debut and not ruled out.
runners.comment: Recorded third AW win in July and didn't run bad the first time at Galway; hurdling debut

runners.name: Le Roi Arthur
runners.spotlight: Stepped up from his poor point form when third on hurdling debut at Sligo (2m2f, good); ran poorly in a Navan bumper in September and was detached when falling at Roscommon earlier this month.
runners.comment: Poor point form but okay third on rules bow; below that twice since

runners.name: Really Truly
runners.spotlight: Relatively ignored in the market on her debut at Tramore and was tailed off; hood worn that day left off.
runners.comment: Ignored in market when tailed off on her debut; hood worn that day left off

runners.name: Puppet Master
runners.spotlight: Ex-Ballydoyle; won a Listed race at Lingfield last year; purchased for 78,000gns in October but has been soundly beaten in two starts over hurdles and two Flat races for new yard; needs to improve.
runners.comment: Won a Listed race last year but soundly beaten in four starts for new yard

runners.name: Jodoro
runners.spotlight: Minor promise in bumpers but the same can't be said of his three maiden hurdle runs; best watched.
runners.comment: Minor promise in bumpers but same can't be said of his three m'den hurdle outings

runners.name: Anns Getaway
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in both maiden hurdle starts; third of five in a point-to-point in March; unlikely.
runners.comment: Tailed off in both m'dens; third of five in a point in march; unlikely

runners.name: Rose Mountain
runners.spotlight: Nothing to recommend her based on four moderate runs at huge prices.
runners.comment: Nothing to recommend her based on four moderate runs at huge prices

runners.name: Grabat
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on debut in a bumper here and none too fluent on hurdles debut at Killarney last month; can only be watched.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in a bumper here and none too fluent on hurdling bow last time; watch

runners.name: Charles The Bold
runners.spotlight: Finally won a point-to-point in April at the 12th time of asking; tailed off over 2m3f here on rules bow; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Won a point at 12th time of asking in April; tailed off on rules bow here

runners.name: Hinchinbrooke
runners.spotlight: A 1m2f AW winner for Jane Chapple Hyam last year; tailed off in two starts over hurdles so plenty of improvement needed.
runners.comment: British AW winner last year; tailed off in two starts over hurdles

races.race_name: Follow Kilbeggan On Instagram Novice Hurdle

runners.name: Mino Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: AQPS winner; joined Willie Mullins; left the champion trainer after five races to join Gordon Elliott; took advantage of a 10lb concession when much too strong for his former stablemate Beauvallon (odds-on) at Bellewstown; clear of the remainder when second to the smart Mullins-trained Witches Familiar at Galway.
runners.comment: Ex-Willie Mullins, beat a Closutton horse at Bellewstown, no match for another at Galway

runners.name: La Cote Fleurie
runners.spotlight: Sent off favourite when winning a Tipperary bumper on good-to-yielding on debut last October; returned from seven-month break when third on hurdles debut over 2m3f at Cork in May; left clear at the last to land the odds in a 2m4f maiden at Limerick later that month.
runners.comment: Left clear at the last to land the odds in a 2m4f maiden at Limerick in May, could feature

runners.name: Rosie's Wings
runners.spotlight: Fair bumper form for Lorna Fowler without winning; produced an improved display to win a 2m Punchestown maiden in June; ran as well as could have been expected when taking third behind the two market leaders in a 2m4f Galway novice event.
runners.comment: third behind the two market leaders in a 2m4f Galway novice event, place chance again now

runners.name: Magico
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat in Britain, rated 89; made a winning start for this yard over hurdles at Killarney in May (2m1f, gd-yld); heavy defeat in a Punchestown novice too bad to be true; returned with a small graze on right-fore cannon bone, possibly picked up when blundering five out.
runners.comment: Useful on the Flat, won on hurdles debut, excuse at Punchestown, should be in the mix now

runners.name: Katie Can't Count
runners.spotlight: Well-related mare; raced keenly and looked raw when fourth on debut in a bumper at Downpatrick in June; hooded now; tough task against experienced rivals.
runners.comment: Well-related, raw when beaten favourite in a bumper, tough task against experienced rivals

runners.name: Lakewood Rose
runners.spotlight: Consistent at a modest level in handicap hurdles until below her best at Cork last time; this is very demanding
runners.comment: Consistent at a modest level in handicap hurdles until last time; this is very demanding

runners.name: Facile Ocean
runners.spotlight: Placed three times in maiden hurdles at this venue before making all for an emphatic in a 2m contest here 13 days ago; no issue with this trip; others are much better suited by the race conditions.
runners.comment: Recent 2m course maiden winner, others are much better suited by the race conditions.

runners.name: Eaglewood
runners.spotlight: Best form has been at Tipperary, where she won a bumper and was placed on her handicap debut last October; two unplaced handicap runs this season; faces an unenviable task at these weights.
runners.comment: Two unplaced handicap hurdle runs this season, faces an unenviable task at these weights

runners.name: No Mon No Fun
runners.spotlight: Not a big price in two point-to-points start but failed to complete; remote fourth over 2m4f on hurdling debut at Limerick; stepped up from that, winning a maiden over a shorter trip at Ballinrobe a month ago; second, third and fourth were from top stables; more on his plate now,
runners.comment: Beat fancied rivals from top yards in a Ballinrobe maiden, more on his plate now

races.race_name: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Pride Of Place
runners.spotlight: Three-time chase winner, including at Killarney in May (3m2f, good to yielding) is 0-6 over hurdles so has a 24lb lower mark in this discipline; hasn't contested a hurdle race since 2024 and never for this yard so he looks like a huge danger to all off this mark but this trip looks tight for him.
runners.comment: Good recent form over fences and rated 24lb lower in this discipline; trip a worry

runners.name: Andyourbirdcansing
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; both wins were at Sligo, including on penultimate off 84 (2m5f, good); below best back at Sligo last time.
runners.comment: Reserve; both wins were at Sligo inc' on penultimate off 84; below best there latest

runners.name: Somersby Roost
runners.spotlight: Came home 7l to the good in a 2m3f handicap at Cork (2m3f, good) before failing to complete her two latest starts at Listowel (3m, good to yielding) and back at Cork (2m4f, good); hard to trust after that.
runners.comment: Easy winner at Cork but PU in latest two starts; hard to trust now

runners.name: Diamond Tipp
runners.spotlight: Won a Downpatrick maiden hurdle last year for John McConnell; no show in opening two starts for this yard, but her runner-up finish at Cork last time was much better (2m2f, good); Jack Kennedy remains aboard and cheekpieces go on; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Much improved when runner-up last time; Kennedy stays aboard and cheekpieces on

runners.name: Blue Reed
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D in May off 87 (good to yielding); bounced back from a poor Killarney run back here over 2m last time when denied by a neck (2m, good); up 3lb more now but the claimer negates that and he likes it around here.
runners.comment: Won off 87 over C&D in May and was a neck second here latest; chance

runners.name: Magic Day
runners.spotlight: C&D winner off 2lb lower last year (yielding); form since then doesn't excite too much but she was better reverted to hurdles over C&D last time when taking the runner-up spot in first-time cheekpieces; place chance.
runners.comment: C&D winner ran well returned to hurdles here last time when runner-up; place chance

runners.name: Steps In The Sand
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; dual-purpose performer was very progressive on the Flat last year; didn't run badly at Sligo two weeks ago when a 4.5l fourth of 16 (2m2f, good).
runners.comment: Reserve; progressive on Flat last year; didn't run badly at Sligo over hurdles latest

runners.name: Malikanna
runners.spotlight: Fine 1l second on handicap debut at Limerick in March (2m, soft); didn't quite see ou the 2m4f at Wexford (good to yielding); stamina doubts not disproven here last time (2m5f, good) when mistakes and being hampered also played a role in a moderate showing; dropped 2lb and Mark Walsh rides for the first time.
runners.comment: Fine 1l second on h'cap bow but below that level over 2m4f last twice; dropped 2lb
runners.owner: Eamon Nolan & Mrs Catherine Anne Nolan

runners.name: Cocovic
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in three maiden hurdles (including here) last summer; made a positive return to action at Limerick in May when a 10l third (2m4f, soft) but didn't find the expected improvement back there last time (2m4f, good, 5-2)) when beaten 22l; must bounce back.
runners.comment: Positive seasonal return when third but must bounce back from poor run latest
runners.owner: Treaty Retail Invest' Holdings Ltd/Denis Murphy B'stock Ltd

runners.name: The Monkey Pole
runners.spotlight: Placed in two maiden hurdles last summer but this years form has been poor; third of 18 in a maiden hurdle at Cork (2m2f, good) last time, but he was 23l behind the winner; needs to build on that to get involved.
runners.comment: Third in a Cork m'den was a bit better this season but needs to build on that

runners.name: Parkgarve
runners.spotlight: Best form has come at Downpatrick (although lightly raced away from there); coasted 12l clear over 2m2f there last time (good) in first-time blinkers; got an easy lead that day in a lower grade at his favourite track, so may not find it so simple to repeat.
runners.comment: Benefitted from an easy lead in a lower grade to win by 12l latest; repeat looks harder

runners.name: Mysilverriverfeale
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough at the eighth time of asking under rules (sixth in maiden hurdles) when beating Facile Ocean by 1.75l over C&D last time (good); runner-up won by 14l next time; mark looks fair enough for handicap bow and Dan King rides again; a lot to like.
runners.comment: Won a C&D m'den last time and runner-up won by 14l next time; a lot to like

runners.name: Bhean Saibhre
runners.spotlight: Won a Ballinrobe maiden hurdle by 16l last summer (2m3f, good); put some underwhelming efforts behind her back at the scene of her win last time when a 3.75l runner-up (2m2f, good); can be hit or miss and up 2lb.
runners.comment: A bit hit or miss but was runner-up at Ballinrobe last time; up 2lb

runners.name: Secret Rock
runners.spotlight: Won over 2m here on stable debut in May off 98 (good to yielding); didn't back it up at Killarney next time, but a bit more promise when ninth at Ballinrobe last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Won over 2m here on stable debut in May; below that afterwards; others preferred

runners.name: Paul Collins
runners.spotlight: Won a novice handicap at Galway in October but struggled since and was beaten 23l in a Galway handicap last time (2m6f, good).
runners.comment: Struggled since winning a novice event in Oct'; beaten 23l latest

runners.name: Emesteraye
runners.spotlight: Has finished third in all three 2m1f handicaps to date on good ground; raised 3lb for her Galway effort last time when closing late on in a first-time tongue tie (retained); Dan King rode her that day but today sticks with Mysilverriverveale; shortlisted all the same.
runners.comment: Third in all three h'caps; up 3lb for her latest effort but this trip may suit

runners.name: Cloonainra
runners.spotlight: Two hurdle wins at 2m2f but has lost her way since Listowel novice chase win in September; others in better form.
runners.comment: Dual hurdles winner is out of form at the moment so others make more appeal

runners.name: Kome Dans Un Reve
runners.spotlight: First reserve; beaten 24l+ in both handicaps to date; plenty of improvement needed.
runners.comment: Reserve; beaten 24l+ in both handicaps to date; plenty of improvement needed

runners.name: Solar Generation
runners.spotlight: Produced a much-improved effort on third hurdle start here last time (2m, good to yielding); check market for his handicap debut.
runners.comment: Much improved on third hurdle start when fifth here; check market for h'cap debut

races.race_name: Peadar's Bar Moate Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Dad Sez
runners.spotlight: Cost 70,000euros as a 3yo; disputing the lead when unseated five out on point-to-point debut at Necarne in May; made a positive first outing under rules when 6.25l fifth of 20 at Galway three weeks ago (2m6f, good); repeat of that would likely be enough and this extra trip should help too.
runners.comment: A repeat of his fifth at Galway on rules debut three weeks ago would likely suffice

runners.name: L'As de Watt
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a Cork maiden hurdle last November but no sign of that form in three runs since; the tongue-tie will have to make a major difference.
runners.comment: Runner-up November but no sign of that since; tongue-tie must make huge difference

runners.name: Benner Wenner
runners.spotlight: Never landed a blow at Ballinrobe on debut but took the second spot at Wexford last time (3m1f, good) albeit the form doesn't amount to much; had Pacy Macie 16l behind that day; needs to improve.
runners.comment: Second at Wexford but the form doesn't amount to much; needs to improve

runners.name: Lady Felicia
runners.spotlight: Fine run when 100-1 in a 2m maiden hurdle at Ballinrobe on her debut, beaten 17l and splitting two subsequent winners; didn't improve when fifth back at Ballinrobe last time (2m2f, good); looked in need of further in both those runs and she gets it here; could go well.
runners.comment: Fine efforts in opening m'dens; upped markedly in trip and it could suit her
runners.owner: Ms Margaret Nevin & Ms Alana Insole

runners.name: Georges Park
runners.spotlight: Order Of St George gelding; dam, by Yeats, unraced half-sister to smart hurdle/chase winner Maiden In Taipan; probably of longer-term interest.
runners.comment: Dam unraced half-sister to smart Maiden In Taipan; likely a longer-term prospect

runners.name: Idaho Expresso
runners.spotlight: 1-9 in point-to-points; poor form in first three starts over hurdles; unlikely.
runners.comment: 1-9 in point-to-points; poor form in first three starts over hurdles; unlikely

runners.name: Pacy Macie
runners.spotlight: Best effort in three point-to-points was a 13l second in April and the winner of that race has since placed in a bumper; third at Wexford (3m1f, good) on rules bow, but was 16l behind the second-placed Benner Wenner.
runners.comment: 16l behind Benner Wenner on rules bow at Wexford so work to do

runners.name: Go To The Moon
runners.spotlight: Bought for 40,000GBP after winning a point in 2025; however, has struggled badly in a Sligo bumper and a Roscommon maiden hurdle, beaten 78l in the latter race; questions to answer now.
runners.comment: Bought for 40,000GBP after 2025 point win; has struggled badly in two runs under rules
runners.owner: A Cahill, M Dowd, P Glancy Partnership

races.race_name: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase

runners.name: Zolpharine
runners.spotlight: Gained back-to-back wins in May, easily over fences at Limerick (2m7f, good, OR 77) and hurdles at Tramore (2m6f, good, OR 75); disappointed off his new mark in a 3m1f chase here 13 days ago when last of four and tailed off in the four-runner field; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Chase/hurdles winner in May; disappointed off new mark over fences here latest

runners.name: Lecale's Diamond
runners.spotlight: Shed his maiden tag at Wexford in May when winning a 3m handicap hurdle off 87 (good to yielding); way below that level on his handicap chase bow at Killarney (2m7f, good to yielding) last time when tailed off; stable has hit form in the meantime and blinkers go on so he might be worth another go as he had run with credit in his two beginners'.
runners.comment: Tailed off last time on h'cap chase bow but could be worth another go with stable in form

runners.name: One Way Traffic
runners.spotlight: Maiden from 15 starts but has looked on the verge of a breakthrough recently; 1.25l behind the winner when second at Limerick in May (2m4f, good to yielding) and just 0.5l behind when filling the same spot at Roscommon last time (3m1f, soft), pair pulled well clear; up 6lb in total for those two performances but big player.
runners.comment: 0-15 but on verge of a breakthrough following two runner-up finishes last twice; player

runners.name: Broken Ice
runners.spotlight: Ended a barren spell when pouncing late at Perth in 2025 over hurdles (3m, good); best run of the season came in the same race last time when a 1.75l third of 11; 1-27 in chases, but this is just his second attempt in this low grade.
runners.comment: 1-27 in chases but this is just his 2nd run in this low grade; not bad over hurdles latest

runners.name: Joe's Turn
runners.spotlight: Dual point-to-point winner is 1-4 over fences, with the victory coming over C&D in 2024 off 4lb lower; got a first hurdles win here last year (3m1f, yielding); well beaten on seasonal return at Punchestown in May and didn't improve at Sligo last time; return to this venue could spark him.
runners.comment: Chase/hurdle wins have come here; poor in two runs this term; this venue must spark him

runners.name: Fr Gilligansvoyge
runners.spotlight: Somehow, the veteran has found top form at the ripe age of 13; won at Downpatrick in June off 72 (3m, good) and held form well when placed twice at Wexford over 2m4f/3m1f; landed a third career success when an easy winner at Tramore last time (2m6f, good); up 6lb for that but has to be on the shortlist considering his form.
runners.comment: Veteran has found top form recently, winning twice this summer inc' latest; shortlisted

runners.name: Sampoet
runners.spotlight: 1-16 in points but yet to make the breakthrough in 15 starts over hurdles and fences; finished 8.25l behind Fr Gilligansvoyge at Downpatrick in June; tailed off in sole completed start since.
runners.comment: 1-16 in points but 0-15 over hurdles and fences; 8.25l behind Fr Gilligansvoyge in June

runners.name: Gorthill
runners.spotlight: Four point wins and snared a maiden hunter chase three years ago; two runs for this yard don't provide too much encouragement.
runners.comment: Four-time point and hunter chase winner; two runs for this yard not encouraging

runners.name: Our Zebo
runners.spotlight: 3-15 over hurdles but remains a maiden over fences after four runs and rated 25lb lower; ran okay off this mark at Tramore last August but lacks a recent and is best watched unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: 3-15 over hurdles but 0-4 chasing; lacks a run so best watched unless market speaks

runners.name: Seventy Eight Team
runners.spotlight: 0-15 under rules and was pulled up twice at Punchestown over hurdles and then fences before tailed off when out of her depth in a Galway beginners' last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: 0-15 under rules and poor recent form; others preferred

runners.name: Deadheat
runners.spotlight: Veteran has been lightly raced in recent years, with poor form shown; new cheekpieces need to reverse the march of time.
runners.comment: Veteran has shown poor form in handful of runs in recent years; unlikely

runners.name: Glendine Billy
runners.spotlight: Winless from 15 tries over hurdles; respectable efforts without threatening the last twice at Wexford; related to winning chaser O'Faolains Lad so perhaps this discipline can unlock more from him.
runners.comment: 0-15 over hurdles; related to winning chaser so maybe this discipline can unlock more

runners.name: He Fitz In
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner but nothing since March 2024 when he won a heavy ground handicap chase at Limerick off 94 (3m1f); wasn't shaping like a winner in waiting towards the end of last season; needs to find his form but perhaps the break has done him good.
runners.comment: No wins since March 2024; poor towards end of last season but perhaps the break has helped

runners.name: Tullabrack Lad
runners.spotlight: Maiden ran well enough off this mark at Down Royal (3m2f, good, 50-1) when beaten 10l in fifth; needs to find more to win.
runners.comment: Maiden ran okay off this mark in April; needs to find more to win

races.race_name: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase

runners.name: Scalpnagoon
runners.spotlight: Two wins over hurdles, maiden chaser; beaten 9l by Charlie Luciano in a C&D beginners' event on penultimate start; 7lb better off, could go close.
runners.comment: Beaten 9l by Charlie Luciano in a C&D beginners' event, 7lb better off, could go close

runners.name: Ira Hayes
runners.spotlight: Fortunate to win a Tramore beginners' event in April; ran well in a Market Rasen handicap before a poor run at Perth; bounced back from that when fourth in a handicap chase at Galway.
runners.comment: Bounced back from a poor run at Perth when fourth in a handicap chase at Galway

runners.name: Ad Caelum
runners.spotlight: Has a good record over hurdles at this venue; has yet to score in 13 starts over fences; pulled up in a handicap hurdle at Galway last time; stablemate The Dara Man is more interesting.
runners.comment: Has a good record over hurdles at this venue, has yet to score in 13 starts over fences

runners.name: Koori Star
runners.spotlight: Better hurdler than chaser; has won on good ground but seems more effective on soft; may have needed his hurdles run at Galway after a break.
runners.comment: Better hurdler than chaser, has won on good ground but seems more effective on soft

runners.name: The Dara Man
runners.spotlight: Modest strike-rate of 3-41 over fences, although one of wins was gained at this venue in August 2024 at Kilbeggan; finished in front of Charlie Luciano when third here in May; lying second when falling three out at Killarney; 19lb below his last winning mark.
runners.comment: Lying second when falling three out at Killarney, in front of Charlie Luciano here in May

runners.name: Charlie Luciano
runners.spotlight: Four wins over hurdles; C&D chase winner last month, much too strong for Scalpanagoon; ran well to finish fourth in a higher grade in the Galway Blazers; has improved since finishing behind The Dara Man here in May; Dara McGill's 7lb claim is a help.
runners.comment: Four wins over hurdles, C&D chase winner last month, ran well in a higher grade at Galway

runners.name: Ceanndana
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner, 2-11 over fences; course winner of a 3m1f handicap hurdle; was staying on at the finish of a 2m4f handicap chase at this venue recently on only his second 2026 start.
runners.comment: Course winner of a 3m1f handicap hurdle, staying on at the finish of a 2m4f race last time

runners.name: A Wave Of The Sea
runners.spotlight: Three course wins to his name, best form at 2m4f; below-par on last two visits here; however, unwise to rule out given his overall record at this track.
runners.comment: Three course wins to his name, best form at 2m4f, below-par on last two visits here

runners.name: Granville Street
