runners.spotlight: His run on the Flat at Galway may have come too soon after a satisfactory hurdles run at the same venue (fourth in a 19-runner 2m6f event); lack of chasing experience is a concern.
runners.comment: His run on the Flat at Galway may have come too soon after a satisfactory hurdles run

races.race_name: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race

runners.name: Hill Silver
runners.spotlight: Remote fourth behind a Willie Mullins-trained winner on debut at Killarney in May; took a big step in the right direction when taking the same place in a Galway festival bumper; this is a much weaker race; looks the part.
runners.comment: Promising fourth in a Galway festival bumper, this is a much weaker race, looks the part

runners.name: Baymount
runners.spotlight: Too keen in her two maiden hurdle outings, pulled up both times; settled a bit better in front for this rider in a bumper at Wexford a fortnight ago and outran her 66-1 odds to finish third behind a Willie Mullins-trained mare; could go close in what looks like a modest contest.
runners.comment: Too keen over hurdles and pulled up twice, much better in a recent bumper,  could go well

runners.name: Long Story
runners.spotlight: Respectable effort over C&D, well beaten at Ballinrobe on either side of that; no appeal.
runners.comment: Respectable effort over C&D, well beaten at Ballinrobe on either side of that, no appeal

runners.name: A Quest For Cognac
runners.spotlight: Fell on her sole point-to-point start; completely tailed off in a recent bumper at Wexford; hooded now.
runners.comment: Fell on her sole point-to-point start; completely tailed off in a recent bumper at Wexford

runners.name: Bellahill
runners.spotlight: Second foal; Poets Word gelding closely related to 1m winner Yellow Bear; dam 6f/7f winner by Holy Roman Emperor; beaten 20l in third in maiden point this season before last; winner Newbrook Diamond and runner-up Court Compliance have won over hurdles; in good hands.
runners.comment: Beaten by two subsequent hurdle winners on his only point-to-point start, in good hands

runners.name: In Around Thehouse
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother by Idaho to useful staying hurdle/chase winner Inch House; dam is from a family associated with talented jumpers; fell five out at Loughrea 15 months ago on his only point-to-point start.
runners.comment: Half-brother by Idaho to useful staying hurdle/chase winner Inch House, fell in a point

runners.name: Lone Ash Lad
runners.spotlight: Gelding by Gustav Klimt, dam placed at two, closely related to US 1m4f turf stakes/GB 1m5f AW Listed winner High Heel Sneakers (dam of 1m4f Group 1 winner Sweet Lady); very capable point-to-point rider booked.
runners.comment: Gustav Klimt gelding with a decent Flat pedigree, very capable point-to-point rider booked

runners.name: Reafadda
runners.spotlight: Introduced in good company at Galway, finished last of six; this is more realistic at least.
runners.comment: Introduced in good company at Galway, finished last of six, this is more realistic

runners.name: Blackwood Joe
runners.spotlight: Three-figure odds when tailed off in a bumper at Cork early this month; can be ruled out.
runners.comment: Three-figure odds when tailed off in a bumper at Cork early this month, can be ruled out

runners.name: No Brainer
runners.spotlight: Pulled up on both starts in points; struggled in a Killarney bumper; cheekpieces added now to to tongue-toe worn then.
runners.comment: Pulled up on both starts in points, struggled in a Killarney bumper, cheekpieces added now

runners.name: Ddakji
runners.spotlight: Made no impact when a 4-1 chance for an academy hurdle at Leopardstown last December; big price when down the field in a bumper at Cork last month; held by fourth-placed Hill Silver
runners.comment: Down the field in a bumper at Cork last month, held by fourth-placed Hill Silver

races.race_name: Taste The World Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Prodigal Son
runners.spotlight: The addition of blinkers saw him spring a minor surprise at Bath (1m, firm) in April; not at that level on his last three starts, most recently when ninth behind Marsh Benham at Sandown last month.
runners.comment: Bath win in April but less good more recently, over 9l behind Marsh Benham last month

runners.name: Thiscouldbefun
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a C&D handicap eight days ago; unpenalised for that win and officially 5lb ahead of the handicapper but it may not be quite so straightforward this time.
runners.comment: 5lb well in after last week's C&D win but this may not pan out quite so smoothly
runners.owner: Mrs Wendy Jarrett & J S Moore

runners.name: Darvel
runners.spotlight: Won the corresponding race 12 months ago off a 1lb higher mark (for today's rider); solid efforts on last three starts and he's a leading contender.
runners.comment: Won this race off 1lb higher last year; arrives in top form; leading contender

runners.name: Kimeko Glory
runners.spotlight: Three wins over further for her former stable; operating off a reduced mark now but she was put in her place by Thiscouldbefun over C&D last week and could prove vulnerable again; blinkers back on after one run in cheekpieces.
runners.comment: No match for Thiscouldbefun over C&D last week; blinkers replace cheekpieces today

runners.name: Palazzo Persico
runners.spotlight: Won two of his four starts (1m2f-1m4f) since joining Tony Carroll, including for today's rider; dropping back to 1m not sure to play to his strengths though.
runners.comment: Two wins from four runs for Tony Carroll; dropping back to 1m not sure to suit

runners.name: Optimatum
runners.spotlight: He hasn't found his best form in three runs for Rod Millman but he is dropping down the weights and he has one of the more experienced riders on board; could revive.
runners.comment: Yet to shine for Rod Millman but down in weights and could revive

runners.name: Prince Rasam
runners.spotlight: Not won since his debut but he ran a good race when second of 14 at Kempton in May (after seven months off); can go well fresh so his absence isn't a big concern; inexperienced amateur booked.
runners.comment: Good 2nd at Kempton on seasonal return in May; inexperienced amateur on board

runners.name: Marsh Benham
runners.spotlight: Returned from seven months off with a good second at Brighton and went one better at Sandown four weeks ago (both 1m on good to firm); 4lb rise manageable and Simon Walker a positive booking.
runners.comment: Sandown win four weeks ago; 4lb rise fair enough and Simon Walker is booked

races.race_name: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Spirit Of Lyra
runners.spotlight: Promising fourth at Ripon on debut and stepped forward with her easy win at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; the third from that race has won since; more to come and she's the one to beat.
runners.comment: Easy win at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) on second start; the one to beat

runners.name: Chan Noir
runners.spotlight: Had a subsequent nursery winner back in second when winning at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) on debut in June; came up short at Newcastle last month and progress will be needed to take this.
runners.comment: Debut win came in a modest race; no progress on AW latest; improvement required

runners.name: Fillipas
runners.spotlight: Good second on her debut at Bath (5f, good) in June but she failed to build on it at Newbury (6f, good to firm) seven weeks ago; capable of better and she holds each-way claims.
runners.comment: Promising 2nd on Bath debut; no progress at Newbury but she still has time to do better

runners.name: Thanks Harry
runners.spotlight: Down the field at Ascot (7f, good to firm) on debut but that was a strong race and he took a step forward when second of five at Hamilton (6f, good; form handsomely franked on Wednesday); still has more to offer and he's one of the likelier types.
runners.comment: Improved on debut effort when finishing 2nd at Hamilton three weeks ago; more to come

runners.name: Inmyopinion
runners.spotlight: 7,000gns yearling, 16,000gns breeze-up 2yo; fifth foal; closely related to 7f winner Reformation (RPR 80), half-sister to winners Maybe Not (7f-1m including AW; 95) and Glencalvie (1m; 78); dam 7f/8.6f AW winner (91), half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Forest Of Dean; stable off the mark with their 2yos last weekend; hooded on debut; bred to have a future.
runners.comment: 16,000gns breeze-up 2yo; useful pedigree and yard's 2yos off the mark last week; hooded

runners.name: Pent Up Charm
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam placed 7f-8.6f (including AW; RPR 78), half-sister to French 1m2f winner Philaminte; unlikely winner on debut.
runners.comment: Just minor appeal on paper and she would be a surprise winner

runners.name: Lowcountry
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam 5f winner (RPR 62), closely related to winners Acolyte (useful 6f including 2yo) and Amplify (5f/6f), out of unraced sister to 1m2f/1m4f winner Night Orbit; by Mayson so rain shouldn't be an issue; betting to guide.
runners.comment: Dam a minor 5f winner, herself related to a couple of winners; market instructive

runners.name: Vera Lemon
runners.spotlight: 1,400gns yearling; sixth foal; dam placed 1m6f AW (RPR 51), closely related to German 6.5f 2yo Listed winner Gooseley Lane (second dam of smart sprinter Goken); rare 2yo runner for Seamus Mullins.
runners.comment: 1,400gns yearling; rare 2yo runner for the stable; best watched

runners.name: Christmas Is Comin
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam 6f winner (including AW; RPR 83), half-sister to 7f 2yo/1m1f winner In First Place; rare 2yo runner for the stable.
runners.comment: Dam a 6f winner (RPR 83); rare 2yo runner for the stable

runners.name: Reece's Call
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother to 5f AW winner Lunasa (including 2yo; RPR 63); dam unraced sister to 6f/1m winner Royal Silk; stable also represented by Fillipas.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 5f AW winner Lunasa; one of two runners for Rod Millman

runners.name: Kaboom
runners.spotlight: Useful pedigree but he made a modest start to his career when sixth of seven, beaten 13l, in a 6f novice at Newmarket (good to firm; over 5l behind Hello You Ten); should do better at some point.
runners.comment: Modest form when 6th of seven at Newmarket (6f) two weeks ago; bred to do better in time

runners.name: Hello You Ten
runners.spotlight: Recorded RPRs in the 50s in his two runs this summer, beaten nearly 8l at Newmarket 15 days ago; should do better at some point but perhaps when nurseries are on the agenda.
runners.comment: Some promise but modest RPRs in two runs this summer; nurseries may prove more suitable

runners.name: Storm Force Ten
runners.spotlight: 12-1, slowly away and never in contention in a 7f maiden at Kempton 11 days ago; stable may have stronger claims with Hello You Ten.
runners.comment: 12-1, slowly away and never in the hunt in a 7f maiden at Kempton 11 days ago

runners.name: Mr Montgomery
runners.spotlight: 100-1 when well beaten in a 7f novice at Newbury on Saturday; now tried in a hood; should do better at some point.
runners.comment: Well-beaten 100-1 shot on recent Newbury debut (7f); now hooded; can do better

races.race_name: Andy Hardwick & Clive Leonard Memorial Handicap

runners.name: Coyy
runners.spotlight: Two 5f wins this season but only four ran on the second occasion; put in his place at Glorious Goodwood last time but the return to 6f could prove beneficial.
runners.comment: Two 5f wins this year but returning to 6f could be beneficial; one to consider

runners.name: Zen Diva
runners.spotlight: Wide-margin win in a Ripon novice on her reappearance and followed up in a C&D handicap last month (only three ran); well beaten at Glorious Goodwood 24 days ago but could resume her progress back in calmer waters.
runners.comment: Easy wins at Ripon and over C&D on first two runs this year; struggled at Goodwood latest

runners.name: Havana Smile
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when dropped to 5f at Sandown in May; no impact in two subsequent runs and now steps back up a furlong.
runners.comment: 5f win in May but not so good twice since; now returns to 6f; not discounted

runners.name: Kohana Nation
runners.spotlight: He has improved with each of his three starts, readily accounting for three rivals on his return to action at Doncaster (6f, good to firm); this will demand much more but he still has time on his side; good chance.
runners.comment: Easy win in a weak novice at Doncaster (6f) three weeks ago; this tougher but unexposed

runners.name: Bintola
runners.spotlight: Improved for the switch to handicaps when winning at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in May; not quite so good twice since and needs to produce a career best.
runners.comment: Windsor handicap win in May has been followed by two unplaced efforts; career best needed

runners.name: Inca Heights
runners.spotlight: Ran well over C&D last summer before struggling in good company on his final two starts as a 2yo; no better in two runs this year and the new cheekpieces need to turn things around.
runners.comment: Ended 2025 quietly and has been well beaten both starts this year; now tried in headgear

runners.name: Eternal Solace
runners.spotlight: Has won on turf but this season's best efforts, notably when second at Newcastle on Good Friday, have come on AW; slow starts have been an issue on last two starts; talented but risky.
runners.comment: Good AW form in spring; slow starts blighted recent efforts; talented but risky

races.race_name: Cara Glass Handicap

runners.name: Violet Goldsmith
runners.spotlight: Improved efforts at Chepstow this summer, second in late May before a comfortable success seven weeks ago (both 1m, good to firm); a 3lb rise shouldn't prevent another big run.
runners.comment: Off the mark at Chepstow seven weeks ago; high on the list up 3lb

runners.name: Court Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f handicap at Kempton off this mark in May; off the boil more recently but the addition of cheekpieces could give her a lift.
runners.comment: 7f AW win off this mark in May; off the boil more recently and now gets headgear

runners.name: Thisonesforyou
runners.spotlight: Improved for the step up to 1m/switch to nurseries when winning at Leicester last October; two creditable efforts on AW last month; one to consider back on turf.
runners.comment: Two creditable AW runs last month; one to consider back on turf

runners.name: Box Clever
runners.spotlight: 7f win here 12 months ago; placed in two of her four runs this year, the latest at Windsor 25 days ago; decent chance provided the ground doesn't get too testing.
runners.comment: Course win as a 2yo (7f); two good runs this year but wouldn't want significant rain

runners.name: Footstepinthewoods
runners.spotlight: Having edged down the weights he got off the mark at the seventh attempt with a hard-fought win at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last month; up 3lb but this isn't a strong 0-70 and he should make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Seventh-time lucky with a hard-fought Windsor win (1m) last month; respected up 3lb

runners.name: Zipwire
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins to his name but his turf form isn't quite of the same standard; modest fourth over C&D last week and he is due to be 2lb lower from the weekend.
runners.comment: Two AW wins to his name but not quite so good on turf; well-held fourth over C&D last week
runners.owner: The 19th Hole Syndicate & J S Moore

runners.name: Florizelle
runners.spotlight: No better than midfield in three novice runs at up to 8.3f; not obviously well treated ahead of her handicap debut but this is at least a more realistic opportunity.
runners.comment: Modest novice form but this minor handicap provides a more realistic opening

runners.name: Crimson Sunset
runners.spotlight: Promise in novice/maiden company; no improvement for the switch to handicaps when sixth of 14 at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) in May but that race didn't go entirely to plan and she returns to action with the potential for a bit better.
runners.comment: No progress on handicap debut in May but still has time to produce a bigger effort

races.race_name: Signs In Motion British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Bintward
runners.spotlight: 780,000euros yearling who comfortably saw off a well-touted Gosden newcomer at Wolverhampton (9.4f; 2-1); should be much too good for these even with a penalty.
runners.comment: Comfortably saw off a well-touted Gosden newcomer at Wolverhampton (9.4f; 2-1)

runners.name: Golden Island
runners.spotlight: Difficult to know what she really acheived when beaten 12l in a four-runner 1m2f novice at Newmarket (good to firm); it would be a big surprise should she topple Bintward.
runners.comment: Difficult to know what she really acheived when beaten 12l in a four-runner 1m2f novice

runners.name: That's All Folks
runners.spotlight: Reportedly lost action and was pulled up when 400-1 for a 1m AW novice 16 days ago; of little account under NH rules.
runners.comment: Reportedly lost action and was pulled up when 400-1 for a 1m AW novice 16 days ago

runners.name: Herstmonceux
runners.spotlight: Weakened at Ffos Las (1m, good), finishing a very remote fifth in a field of eight.
runners.comment: Weakened at Ffos Las (1m, good), finishing a very remote fifth in a field of eight

runners.name: Stopherandgo
runners.spotlight: A very moderate hurdler these days and tailed off in her two Flat races.
runners.comment: A very moderate hurdler these days and tailed off in her two Flat races

races.race_name: Edwards Ford, Foray Motor Group Handicap

runners.name: A Daughters Love
runners.spotlight: Much improved to win by 10l at Ffos Las (1m4f, good) and she was a clear second when 4lb well in back there nine days ago; new mark has kicked in but 1m6f might suit; would have questions to answer if conditions went on the soft side of good.
runners.comment: Beaten off 4lb lower last time but running well over 1m4f and this trip could suit

runners.name: Basilette
runners.spotlight: A winner over hurdles in July; capable on the Flat off this sort of mark and won at Bath in May; should give a good account; goes on all ground.
runners.comment: Won over hurdles in July; capable on the Flat off this sort of mark and won at Bath in May

runners.name: Panthere Noir
runners.spotlight: Second in a field of four when tried over this far three runs back; has since won a 1m2f classified race and finished third in another when penalised; should run well provided his stamina stands the test.
runners.comment: Running well in 1m2f classifieds; should run well provided his stamina stands the test

runners.name: Moab
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose gelding whose sole win came in a 1m6f AW handicap last October off 6lb lower; has performed well under both codes since, last time third of 24 in a handicap hurdle at Punchestown in April; fast ground might not be ideal, so any rain would be a blessing.
runners.comment: 1m6f winner; big run over hurdles last time in April; rain would be a blessing

runners.name: Masterdream
runners.spotlight: Better known as a jumper and hasn't won on the Flat since 2023; it's unclear what his latest second here amounts to as only four ran and the odds-on winner bolted up.
runners.comment: Unclear what latest second here amounts to as four ran and the odds-on winner bolted up

runners.name: Digger One
runners.spotlight: Uncompetitive in two bumpers and the same in three Flat runs (1m2f-1m3f), though the middle effort at Windsor offered some promise with a view to low-grade handicaps.
runners.comment: Middle effort at Windsor offered some promise with a view to low-grade handicaps
